description:

At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. At our core, we Champion People, help our colleagues Grow with Purpose and true to our name we encourage colleagues to “Be Alight.”

With a comprehensive total rewards package, continuing education and training, and tremendous potential with a growing global organization, Alight is the perfect place to put your passion to work.


Join our team if you Champion People, want to Grow with Purpose through acting with integrity and if you embody the meaning of Be Alight.


Learn more at careers.alight.com.

**Position Objective**: The STD Claims Case Manager (CCM) is responsible for administering and case managing assigned Group Short Term Disability claims according to the plan provisions, state and federal guidelines, and established protocols. The CCM works jointly with other team members within STD, and LTD and Risk Management resources. The CCM must demonstrate the knowledge to work independently, make timely claim decisions, and must possess the knowledge and experience which allows performance of the daily activities of the job with minimal supervision.


The CCM is responsible for meeting key service deliverables for turnaround times, quality assurance, and overall customer experience.

**Major Opportunities and Decisions:**


This position utilizes problem solving, analytical, written and verbal communication skills to ensure timely and appropriate disability claim decisions while providing superior customer service to all internal and external customers. This position will review claims for Short Term Disability and requires consistent and effective claim management skills to succeed in a collaborative, team\-oriented culture with a goal to drive positive claim outcomes.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

**Communication (Verbal and Written)**

* Use most efficient and effective means of proactive outreach to obtain and/or dispense information to and from claimants, departmental managers, physicians, HR, Payroll, or any other sources.
* Communicate claim status and decisions via telephone and in writing
* Initiate communications to claimant, physician, and /or Plan holder to obtain information,


make assessment and initial claim decision

* Proactive outreach to claimants, plan holders, and physicians via telephone for information needed for initial and ongoing claim management (e.g. tax returns, partnership records, current earnings other income benefits and medical information etc.,); notifies claimant when claim pended for missing information

  



**Investigate/Analyse**

* Investigate and analyse claim information to determine coverage and benefit eligibility, perform pre\-existing condition investigation and draft adverse determination letter, if applicable. Perform contestability investigation, evaluate for possible rescission and make rescission determination and draft letter if applicable
* Determine disability by comparing functionality with job description by reviewing medical information including physician statement(s) and medical records to set up claim for initial benefit approval
* Determine Insured Earnings by reviewing payroll records, tax returns (including W2s), partnership records and buy sell agreements and calculate payable benefits according to plan provisions
* Follows claim management procedures and identifies potential return to work, job accommodation opportunities when applicable.
* Utilizes claim management resources, i.e. MDA (Medical Disability Advisor), and other disability guidelines, with a goal of returning claimant to active work status
* Assess claim when other sources of income are received (e.g., social security, state disability, etc.,) to ensure accurate offsets are applied and recalculate benefits as needed determining under/overpayments. Proactively work with claimants to recover overpayments in full or negotiate monthly instalments according to established protocol

**Skills and Knowledge:**

* Excellent analytical, problem solving, and communication skills (verbal \& written) essential
* Minimum 2 years of disability claim management experience (STD preferred), or other previous Group insurance experience
* Regulatory and Compliance experience a plus
* Ability to multi\-task and meet turnaround times
* Ability to clearly communicate claim decisions and contract language verbally and in written correspondence
* Understanding of medical terminology and medical conditions helpful

**Education and Experience:**

* Graduate in listed discipline (BA, B.Com, BCA aggregate marks of \>\=55% ( No Gaps / Failure throughout Graduation)
* Work Experience of 6 years \+
* **Ability to work evening/night shifts**
* Minimum 2 years of disability claim management experience (STD preferred), or other previous Group insurance experience
* Regulatory and Compliance experience a plus

**Benefits**


We offer programs and plans for a healthy mind, body, wallet and life because it’s important our benefits care for the whole person. Options include a variety of health coverage options, wellbeing and support programs, retirement, vacation and sick leave, maternity, paternity \& adoption leave, continuing education and training as well as a number of voluntary benefit options.


By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight’s employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: SSN/SIN validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.

**Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**


Alight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful.


At Alight, we welcome and embrace all individuals, regardless of their background, and are dedicated to creating a culture that enables every employee to thrive. Join us in building a brighter, more inclusive future.


We offer you a competitive total rewards package, continuing education \& training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

* Ensure adherence to internal processes, SLAs, and recruiting workflows

description:

**T\&T\- HC\- HRT\- SF EC Payroll\- Manager\- Hyderabad**

**The Team**

Today’s business challenges present a new wave of HR, talent and organization priorities. Deloitte’s Human Capital services leverage research, analytics, and industry insights to help design and execute critical programs from business driven HR to innovative talent, leadership, and change programs. Learn more about Human Capital Practice
**Work you’ll do**
==================

  



As an SAP HCM Payroll Consultant, you will be responsible for implementing, configuring, and supporting SAP Payroll solutions for our clients in India. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand their specific payroll needs, translate those needs into technical requirements, and deliver effective solutions within the SAP HCM landscape, ensuring compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements in India.


* **Requirements Gathering \& Analysis (India Focus):** Conduct workshops and interviews with business users in India to gather requirements specific to Indian payroll, including statutory compliance, tax deductions, allowances, and other relevant areas. Analyze business processes and document "as\-is" and "to\-be" scenarios, considering the nuances of Indian payroll.
* **Solution Design \& Configuration (India Focus):** Design, configure, and test SAP Payroll for India, including components like payroll schema, rules, wage types, and tax calculations, ensuring adherence to Indian legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Income Tax, PF, ESI, Gratuity, etc.).
* **Statutory Compliance (India Focus):** Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of Indian payroll regulations and ensure that the SAP Payroll system is configured to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Manage and implement any changes required due to legal updates.
* **Customization \& Development (India Focus):** Develop functional specifications for custom enhancements related to Indian payroll and work with ABAP developers to ensure proper implementation. May also be involved in basic ABAP debugging related to payroll.
* **Testing \& Quality Assurance (India Focus):** Develop test plans, conduct unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) specifically for Indian payroll processes to ensure the quality and accuracy of SAP Payroll solutions.
* **Training \& Documentation (India Focus):** Create user manuals, training materials, and other documentation specific to Indian payroll processes. Conduct end\-user training sessions for Indian payroll users.
* **Go\-Live \& Support (India Focus):** Support the go\-live process for Indian payroll implementations, including data migration and post\-implementation support. Provide ongoing support to end\-users in India, troubleshooting payroll issues and resolving problems.
* **Project Management:** Contribute to project planning, execution, and tracking. Manage tasks and deliverables within assigned scope.
* **Best Practices \& Standards:** Stay up\-to\-date with SAP HCM best practices and Indian payroll regulations and trends. Contribute to the development of internal methodologies and standards related to Indian payroll.
* **Client Communication (India Focus):** Communicate effectively with clients in India, both verbally and in writing, considering cultural nuances. Build and maintain strong client relationships.

  


**Key Skills \& Experience:**
* 6\-8 years in SAP Payroll, with 5\+ years in **Employee Central Payroll (ECP)**.
* Strong knowledge of **Payroll Control Center (PCC)**, **BIB integrations**, and **EC–ECP data replication**.
* Experience with **payroll schemas, PCRs, off\-cycle payroll, and retro\-calculations**.
* Excellent understanding of **Time, Benefits, and Finance integration touchpoints**.
* SAP SuccessFactors ECP certification preferred.
* Strong client\-facing, leadership, and analytical skills.
* Bachelors or Masters in any field.

title: Customer Success Operations Coordinator, APAC
description:
**Company Overview**



Revinate is a direct booking platform that leads the hospitality industry in driving direct revenue and increased profitability.



Our products and our people combine to give hoteliers the superpowers they need to crush their goals. With Revinate, hoteliers shift share away from OTAs and drive tangible results across an individual property or a portfolio. Our industry\-leading, AI\-powered, customer data platform collects, unifies and, synthesizes data giving hoteliers a foundational advantage.



Hoteliers gain critical intelligence – guest lifetime spend, stay preferences, ancillary revenue, and more. With Revinate’s Rich Guest Profile® data points, hoteliers don’t need to guess who their most profitable guests are, or how to drive conversions across email, voice, messaging, and digital channels.



Revinate's direct booking platform and omnichannel communication technology powers 1\.1 billion Rich Guest Profiles across 12,500\+ hotels to drive over $24 billion in direct revenue.



Be a superhero. Join the mission. Transform the industry.


**Get Revinate. Get superpowers.**


**Role Overview**

The Customer Success Operations Coordinator is a critical execution engine for our APAC Customer Success team. In this supportive role, you will act as the operational "right hand" to our Strategic CSMs, removing administrative hurdles and ensuring high\-velocity execution across multiple time zones.



You will be a "Superuser" of the Revinate suite, blending data reporting, technical troubleshooting, and project coordination. This role is ideal for someone detail\-oriented and process\-driven who wants to learn the inner workings of global account management while delivering a "delightful" service experience to our customers.

  


This is a remote position, but candidates must reside within India based on immediate territory needs.
### **Primary Goals**


* **Operational Excellence:** Execute recurring administrative, contract, and billing tasks for Global Accounts with accuracy.
* **Account Readiness:** Lead the seamless implementation and launch of new Guest Feedback accounts within the APAC region.
* **Data Integrity:** Generate and audit complex performance reports that demonstrate Revinate’s value to our largest global stakeholders.
* **Efficient Resolution:** Act as the first point of contact for Level 1 support inquiries, ensuring rapid resolution and high customer satisfaction.
### **What You Will Do**


#### **Global Account \& Operations Support**


* **Administrative Management:** Manage the lifecycle of Global Account paperwork, including contract amendments, renewals, cancellations, and transfers. As well as supporting the Strategic CSM with administration tasks.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Collaborate with Billing and Sales to resolve payment disputes, credit memo requests, and debt collection inquiries for Global Accounts.
* **Data \& Reporting:** Produce and audit recurring performance reports for Strategic CSMs to share during Executive Business Reviews (EBRs).
* **Alignment:** Participate in daily APAC CS stand\-ups to ensure regional alignment and track the status of global task requests.

#### **Implementation \& Onboarding**


* **Project Management:** Lead the implementation of contracted Revinate products (specifically Guest Feedback) for APAC customers.
* **Technical Launch:** Coordinate with customers and internal technical teams to ensure integrations are completed on time.

#### **Level 1 Technical Support**


* **Queue Management:** Own and respond to Level 1 customer inquiries via Zendesk, maintaining high visibility and responsiveness.
* **Troubleshooting:** Solve non\-standard requests and troubleshoot web\-related issues (browser settings, email rendering, etc.) before escalating complex bugs to Engineering.
* **System Integrity:** Track and log all customer issues in Salesforce to maintain a "source of truth" for the global team.
### **What You Will Bring**

* **Experience:** 1–3 years of professional experience in a SaaS environment, preferably in Customer Success, Support, or Operations.
* **Process Mastery:** You thrive in a dynamic environment and are comfortable managing repetitive, process\-driven work at a high velocity.
* **Communication:** Professional written and verbal communication skills, with a high degree of sensitivity to cultural expectations across the APAC region.
* **Technical Savvy:** Interest in learning new products quickly; experience with Salesforce, Zendesk, or JIRA is highly preferred.
* **Detail Orientation:** You are highly organized and proactive in following up on tasks to ensure nothing "falls through the cracks."
* **Hospitality Affinity:** Previous experience in hospitality or familiarity with hotel systems (OPERA, roomMaster, etc.) is a significant plus.
### **What We Can Offer**

* **Tools \& Tech:** We empower you with the hardware and training to become a product expert.
* **Culture:** A focus on learning and professional development within a passionate, high\-performing team.
* **Meaningful Work:** An opportunity to make a major impact on the hospitality industry by supporting its most influential global brands.

**Interview Process**
We're excited you're considering a career with Revinate! Our goal is to ensure this is the right opportunity for you, while also determining if you're the right fit for our team. The interview process for this role is designed to be a two\-way street, where you'll get to know us just as we get to know you.

\- Recruiter Screen \- 30 minutes via WhatsApp
\- Hiring Manager Interview \- 30 minutes via Google Meet
\- Interview with Team Members \- 45 minutes via Google Meet
\- Final Interview with Team Director \- 30 minutes via Google Meet  



Revinate values the flexibility of a remote workforce and the benefits of localized hiring. We focus on specific cities to foster local communities and enhance team cohesion, allowing employees to collaborate, attend local events, and build a strong sense of community and company culture.
**Candidates must be located in the city listed in the job application. Thank you!**

Revinate is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complementary.  


**Important Security Alert**
We have been made aware of fraudulent activities involving individuals impersonating our HR team and offering fake job opportunities. Please be vigilant and ensure your safety by verifying all job offers.

**For Authentic Opportunities:** Only refer to our official careers page on our company website. Your security is our priority. If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately. Stay safe and secure! You can confirm or inquire with any questions by reaching out to recruiting@revinate.com  



**AI and Hiring**
*Please note that interviews at Revinate will be recorded using* *brighthire.ai**. As we continue to build more structure into our interview processes \- the best way to eliminate unconscious bias! * Translate **business needs into clear functional and non\-functional requirements** for solution / development teams.
* Engage with **internal customer teams, ecommerce, digital, and commercial teams** on product information support and enhancements.
* Manage or support **onboarding and maintenance of product information**, ensuring data is **complete, consistent, validated, and customer ready**.

**Stibo STEP – Techno\-functional Ownership*** Act as a **hands\-on Stibo STEP analyst**, able to:
* + Understand and work with the **Stibo STEP data model** (entities, attributes, hierarchies, relationships, inheritance, etc.).
	+ Able to support requirement analysis and design in **Stibo STEP** **workflows, business rules, validations, UI configurations, dashboards, and tasks**.
	+ Understand **Stibo STEP integration end points** (APIs, exports/imports, downstream feeds) to be able to collaborate with integration teams.
	+ Support **environment configuration, deployments, and defect analysis** in STEP.
* Collaborate with architects and senior engineers to ensure **scalable, robust, and compliant** solutions on the Stibo STEP platform.

**Delivery, Support \& Continuous Improvement*** Ensure **acceptance testing** of solutions (functional testing, regression, data validation, and UAT support).
* Provide **L2/L3 functional and technical support** for issues/errors in PIM and MDM processes, including impact analysis and root\-cause investigation.
* Identify and propose **process and system improvements** to streamline product information flows and enhance data quality.
* Establish, monitor, and report on **KPIs/metrics** around PIM and MDM (data quality, SLA adherence, issue trends, process efficiency).
* Work in an **international, multi\-cultural environment**, aligning with global and regional teams, and managing time zone overlaps as required.

**Stakeholder Management \& Ways of Working*** Manage **stakeholder expectations and communication** (business, IT, vendors), providing clear updates on requirements, timelines, risks, and issues.
* Partner with **project managers, product owners, and scrum teams** to deliver enhancements and projects on time and with quality.
* Demonstrate **strong problem\-solving skills, bias for action, decisiveness, and effective time management** in a fast\-paced environment.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience*** **5–8 years** of total IT experience, preferably in **enterprise applications, data, or digital** domains.
* **Proven hands\-on experience (minimum \~3–4 years) in Stibo STEP MDM/PIM** including:
* + Practical exposure to **Stibo STEP data modeling** for product, hierarchy, and reference data.
	+ Experience with **workflows, business rules, validations, and web UI configuration**.
	+ Familiarity with **integration patterns** (file\-based, API\-based, real\-time/batch) and troubleshooting data/interface issues.
* Solid understanding of **PIM/MDM concepts**, such as:
* + Data governance and stewardship
	+ Product hierarchies, taxonomy, attributes, and classifications
	+ Data quality rules and validations
	+ Multi\-channel product data publishing (ecommerce, marketplaces, internal systems)
* Experience working as a **business analyst, techno\-functional analyst, or product owner proxy** in a product/data platform team.

**Preferred Skills**  

* Experience with **Stibo STEP** in a **SaaS / cloud** environment is an advantage.
* Exposure to **consumer\-packaged goods (CPG)**, retail, or ecommerce product information domains.
* Knowledge of **integration technologies** (e.g., REST APIs, message queues, ETL tools, data pipelines).
* Familiarity with **Agile/Scrum** ways of working.
* Strong **SQL / data analysis** skills to investigate and validate data issues.
* Experience in **defect management, release management, and environment coordination**.

**Competencies \& Behaviors*** **Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills**, with the ability to deep\-dive into data and system behavior.
* **Bias for action** – comfortable taking ownership, driving closure, and making decisions with appropriate stakeholders.
* **Structured and detail\-oriented**, with a focus on data quality and process discipline.
* **Clear and concise communication** skills (verbal and written), able to work with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in an **international, multi\-cultural setup**, collaborating across geographies and functions.
* Team player with a **continuous improvement mindset**.

**Why Join the PIC Team at General Mills?**  

* Opportunity to work on a **strategic Product Information and MDM platform**.
* Be part of a **high\-impact, global transformation journey** with **Stibo STEP** at the core.
* Own a **techno\-functional role** that offers strong exposure to both **business and technology**.
* Collaborative culture with focus on **learning, innovation, and career growth**.


If you have **strong hands\-on experience in Stibo STEP MDM/PIM** and are looking to grow into a **techno\-functional analyst role** driving enterprise product information capabilities, we would be excited to hear from you.

description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  



The role is responsible for end to end HR Operations with strong ownership of Vendor Management, Contract \& Compliance Oversight, Background Verification, Payroll Interfaces, and Audit Readiness. The position supports large scale, multi geography hiring operations and ensures process excellence, SLA adherence, and regulatory compliance, aligned with Optum/UHG standards.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* HR Operations \& Compliance
	+ Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements
	+ Conduct internal and external audits; remediate gaps and drive audit readiness
	+ Maintain strong governance around SLAs, SOPs, and compliance trackers
* Vendor \& Contract Management
	+ Own vendor lifecycle including onboarding, performance monitoring, audits, renewals, and exits
	+ Manage contracts, Statements of Work (SOW), Work Orders (WO), and Purchase Orders (PO)
	+ Ensure vendor adherence to contractual, financial, and compliance obligations
	+ Partner with Legal, Finance, and Procurement on contract governance and risk mitigation
* Billing \& Financial Controls
	+ Validate inputs against PO values, SLAs, and timesheets
	+ Ensure accurate invoicing, billing, and accruals
	+ Track payroll elements including wages, bonuses, revisions, and compliance components
* Reporting, MIS \& Analytics
	+ Maintain comprehensive HR dashboards covering hiring, compliance, vendors, and termination
	+ Prepare periodic operational and audit reports for leadership review
	+ Identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process optimization
* Stakeholder Management
	+ Act as a primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and external vendor partners
	+ Drive continuous improvement, automation, and cost efficiency initiatives
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
* 5\+ years of experience in recruitment operations, vendor management, or HR operations in a fast\-paced, matrixed organization
* Hands on experience with background verification, onboarding, and HR lifecycle processes
* Experience in reporting and analytics with the ability to interpret recruitment data and provide actionable insights
* Working knowledge of employment laws, compliance standards, and data privacy requirements relevant to recruitment
* Solid understanding of end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, operations, and service delivery models (RPO/shared services environments preferred)
* Proven exposure to HRMS platforms (preferably Mercury, ORC \& Taleo)
* Proven solid problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a continuous improvement mindset
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a high\-volume environment
* Proven effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and levels

 **Optum / UHG Role Guidelines (Aligned Add On)**

* Operate with enterprise governance mindset, ensuring all processes are audit ready and policy compliant
* Maintain clear documentation and data traceability for all vendor, hiring, and referral transactions
* Ensure segregation of duties, approval controls, and escalation protocols are followed
* Embed privacy, data security, and ethical standards in all HR and vendor interactions
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and proactive risk identification
* Champion continuous improvement, automation, and efficiency aligned to Optum's transformation agenda
* Act as a trusted partner to TA, Finance, Legal, EP, and Compliance teams

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

 The Mission, Should You Choose to Accept It
 



 Your mission is simple but powerful: build a world\-class team and culture that mirrors our revolutionary AI products. You won't just manage policies; you'll be the architect of our employee experience, a brand ambassador to talent, and a strategic partner in our hyper\-growth.
 



 We need someone who doesn't just "do HR" but lives and breathes the startup hustle. If you're the person friends come to for advice, if you love tech, if you can chat with a software engineer, strategize with the founder, and wow a potential hire all before lunch—this is your stage.

title: Lead Regional HR Business Partner
description:
Overview:

The**Lead** **Regional HR Business Partner** is a senior strategic partner accountable for regional HR outcomes, translating global people frameworks into compliant, culturally effective regional execution. The role drives workforce and leadership effectiveness, partners closely with LOB HRBPs and COEs to ensure aligned, end‑to‑end support, and brings regional insight to enterprise HR strategy. It is a senior IC role that influences enterprise outcomes without formal people‑management responsibility.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Business Partnership**

* Partner closely with Line of Business (LOB)–aligned HR Business Partners and business leaders to align talent strategies, organizational actions, and leadership support across intersecting parts of the business, ensuring clarity of roles, handoffs, and decision ownership.
* Partner with regional senior leaders to align talent, organizational, and workforce strategies with business objectives across one or more countries or regions.
* Partner with LOB HRBP and business leaders to bring forward regional insights (labor market trends, regulatory landscape, talent availability) that inform and shape broader people strategies
**Organizational Effectiveness \& Workforce Strategy**

* Align with LOB HRBP to and execute region\-specific organizational design, workforce planning, and change initiatives, including restructures, role clarity, capacity planning, and future\-state workforce modeling within assigned geographies.
* Partner with LOB HRBP execute region\-specific organizational design, workforce planning, and change initiatives, including restructures, role clarity, capacity planning, and future\-state workforce modeling within assigned geographies.
* Apply advanced organizational development and change management practices to support transformation, growth, and operating model evolution.
**Leadership \& Talent Enablement**

* Coach and advise regional senior leaders on leadership effectiveness, team dynamics, dispersed teams, performance management, and talent decisions.
* Coordinate with LOB HRBP to support succession planning, leadership readiness, and development planning for critical roles, informed by regional talent availability and capability needs.
**Regional HR Ownership**

* Serve as the primary point of accountability for regional labor law expertise and risk mitigations, ensuring people decisions are compliant, practical, and aligned to local requirements. Own end‑to‑end regional HR delivery across assigned geographies,, balancing global standards with local labor laws, market realities, and cultural norms to ensure practical, business‑relevant decisions.
* Lead complex, multi\-country employee matters, partnering with legal, ER, and regional leaders to mitigate risk and ensure disciplined, compliant execution aligned with enterprise standards.
* Lead or contribute to enterprise\-wide HR initiatives (culture, engagement, leadership frameworks, workforce transformations, DEI), ensuring effective adoption and relevance within the region.
 **Scope \& Role Characteristics**

* Works in a matrixed HRBP model, requiring strong collaboration and alignment with Line of Business–aligned HR Business Partners to deliver integrated outcomes across shared client groups.
* Owns delivery for large, complex, or high\-impact client groups, initiatives, or regional populations.
* Influences outcomes through credibility, expertise, and partnership rather than formal authority.
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred.
* 8–12\+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant experience in a senior HR Business Partner or equivalent role.
* Demonstrated experience supporting leaders across multiple countries and regions, with exposure to differing employment laws, cultures, and workforce models.
* Proven success operating in global, matrixed environments, partnering with both local leaders and global HR teams.
* Strong experience across multiple HR disciplines, including organizational effectiveness, employee relations, workforce planning, talent strategy, and change management.
**Professional Capabilities**

* Strong executive presence and credibility with senior leaders across geographies.
* Strategic, systems\-oriented thinker with the ability to balance global consistency and local nuance.
* Excellent judgment and discretion when navigating complex, high\-risk people decisions.
* Advanced consulting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Data\-informed decision\-maker comfortable navigating ambiguity and scale.
  


Basic Qualifications:
* Bachelor's Degree
* Significant experience executing in multiple human resource disciplines including compensation practices, organizational diagnosis, employee relations, diversity, performance management, federal and state respective employment laws
* Significant experience as a HR Business Partner (or equivalent role)
* Significant expertise and experience serving in a consultative capacity to senior business leaders, shaping organizational strategy, goals and alignment
* Demonstrated success in effectively envisioning, developing, and implementing new strategies to address competitive, complex business issues
* Microsoft Windows and Office proficient
* HR Professional certification and/or coursework
* Excellent conflict management skills
* Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills
* Excellent oral and written communications skills that demonstrate a professional demeanor and the ability to interact with others with discretion and tact
* Demonstrated ability to establish rapport and gain the trust of others in order to achieve results
* Able to thrive in a fast paced, deadline driven environment
* Possess a strong executive presence and a successful track record of partnering with business leaders
* Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and tact
* Up to 10% travel time required
* Or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the principal duties of the job
* Demonstrated leadership skills

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
*Resolver operates as a hybrid workforce with the option to work at home, in the office, or a mix of both. Ideally we're looking for someone who's able to collaborate in person in our Hyderabad office once or twice a week.*  


We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our team and help scale hiring across North America. You’ll partner closely with hiring leaders and act as a trusted advisor. This role sits within Resolver’s Talent Acquisition team, with approximately 50% of your time dedicated to supporting hiring efforts across Kroll.

This is an opportunity to shape how we hire — from building smart recruiting strategies to delivering a standout candidate experience from first touch to offer stage. You thrive in full\-cycle recruitment, move quickly, think creatively, and know how to attract top talent in competitive markets.

You know great hiring doesn’t come from simply posting jobs and hoping for the best. You’re proactive, curious, and always experimenting with new ways to connect with talent. Reporting to the Talent Acquisition Lead, you’ll play a key role in helping us grow the teams that power Resolver’s success.  

**About Resolver:**
Resolver is a high\-growth SaaS company whose intuitive, no\-code platform gives our customers a clear picture of their risks so they can make quick and effective decisions. As a part of the Resolver team, your work will help transform risk management to risk intelligence so organizations can protect people and assets and deliver on their purpose.
We are ambitious in both our mission and our culture. As a business within Kroll, we offer an innovative, non\-hierarchical work environment blended with the stability and financial security of an enterprise.  

**Your day to day \- let's break it down!:****Recruitment (85%)***Measures of Success: Quality of hires, fill\-ratio, time\-to\-fill, and source of hire** Engage talent: Identify the right people, get them engaged, and lead the candidate experience through the full hiring process
* Build strategic relationships with hiring teams: We are a global and forward\-thinking team which means you will work with a variety of roles both technical and commercial. You will craft and enhance a consistent and outstanding candidate experience
* Source high quality candidates: You will leverage all talent acquisition channels – networking, events, headhunting, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, etc. This may include targeted recruiting efforts for specific teams.
* Lead candidate searches: With a strong lens on diversity and inclusion, be a trusted resource for how critical inclusive talent strategies are to truly finding the best candidate for the role and Resolver.
* Champion and foster our hiring process: Provide a consistent experience with the Resolver recruiting team
* Participate with the global recruiting team: Help develop, implement, and execute recruiting strategies. Our distributed model means working with global teams and candidates, with the freedom to focus on the right candidate, regardless of location.
* Be a passionate Resolver brand ambassador before, during, and after recruitment. Help us build our talent brand in addition to our talent pipeline

**Talent Acquisition (15%)***Measures of Success: Acceleration of talent acquisition initiatives** Act as a champion within the Talent Team to build the overall talent acquisition strategy and expand our employer brand
* Assists with the Talent Team’s event strategy to build a diverse team of Resolverites
* Attends technology industry networking events to build our talent pipeline
* Work on projects as needed to improve the efficiency of the Resolver recruitment engine

**What you will bring:*** 3\-5 years of recruiting experience across a range of positions and teams, ideally from both and agency and corporate environment with experience hiring technical roles
* Experience collaborating with and influencing hiring managers and executives throughout the recruiting cycle. A passion for understanding what makes the right match for Resolver.
* Experience recruiting for a fast\-paced company. Maybe it's a software company and, better yet, even a company where talent isn't knocking down your door
* Champion diversity \- go beyond the corporate speak of DEI recruiting to be what a true champion is \- focused, energized, takes the time to master the art and science, becomes an authority and is someone the team looks up to.
* Solid understanding of ATS tools (JobVite or Oracle Recruiting Cloud are a bonus!) and recruiting technologies
* Ability to effectively articulate the Resolver value proposition and story to candidates

**What we’ll give you in return**
Culture isn't just something we write about (although we do), we live our values and challenge each other to be our best selves. We invest in Resolverites who will grow with us. We have a comprehensive rewards package to show our team our appreciation for everything they do:


* Great benefits: 100% paid by us for health, accident and life, medical privileges include dental and outpatient too. We also offer a wellness/fitness reimbursement, that can go towards things like gym memberships, yoga classes, soccer membership fees or a cycle.
* Vacation: It’s important for you to have time off to re\-charge your battery and be with your family and friends. Paid time and sick/casual accrual are 15 days and 12 days per year respectively.
* Team: we have smart, talented and curious people you'll work with and learn from. As a Product company, you'll be hands\-on with our global teams and top\-tier leadership in Canada, the US, and UK
* Professional development: we have an external learning budget to help you grow and develop. We also have great online learning and workshops internally for you to tap in to.  

Impact: we solve complex challenges for some of the world's most recognized organizations. Our customers use our software to help reduce the frequency and severity of negative events to protect people, product and organizational success. What we do matters.
* Parental leave: we support new Mothers with 100% top\-up Maternity leave is up to 26 weeks and new Fathers receive 10 days of Welcome Leave.
* Office perks: our environment is flexible, with great snacks and chai. We love our newly renovated office and table tennis. We do socials and events for people to come together.
* Learning: we invest in the development of our people through online learning, group learning and external learning.

**Interested?**
Resolver is committed to providing accommodations for all persons with disabilities. If at any point in the recruitment process you require accommodation, please notify the applicable recruiter or contact us directly at careers@resolver.com

**We Are Teva**
We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world\-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high\-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high\-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.**The Opportunity**

The position requires an experienced and dynamic HR leader who can effectively drive talent management, OD/OE (organization development and effectiveness), leadership development, recruitment, employee and union relations, change leadership, and employee engagement initiatives.

The HR Director drives the development and implementation of human resources priorities and objectives for the cluster in alignment with the broader organizational priorities.

Responsibilities include developing, planning and delivering HR programs and services to the Organization, as well as supporting the business strategy and objectives through people management expertise. Provide customer\-focused consultancy that adds value, helps the organization achieve successful results, and is valued by management and employees.**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
* Support Site Leadership team in forecasting the workforce plans and talent pipeline requirements in line with the business strategy. Leads annual talent management processes for the site population.
* Serves as a confidant to site leaders on HR related issues.
* Review key business performance targets and their related talent implications with business leaders.
* Drive talent management strategies to proactively develop employees in alignment with current and future capabilities.
* Supports organizational change and design by working with senior management and HR to identify business requirements and implement appropriate solutions.
* Lead and manage all aspects of collective labor relations, including the negotiation and renewal of Long\-Term Settlements (LTS) and wage agreements with recognized trade unions, ensuring compliance with applicable labor legislation while advancing site operational needs and organizational objectives. Serve as the primary management representative in conciliation proceedings, grievance escalations, and labor authority engagements, and develop proactive strategies to sustain constructive union\-management relations across sites.
* Employs effective change management strategies to aid in business transformation initiatives.
* Works closely with leadership and employees to improve engagement, retention, and organizational effectiveness aimed at delivering stronger business performance.
* Develop and promote ongoing feedback mechanisms for employees to influence continuous improvement.
* Manage, guide and resolves complex employee relations issues. Conducts effective, thorough and objective investigations.
* Identify and drive the sharing of best practices across functions to facilitate continuous improvement.
* Act as a liaison between the business and HR to ensure that HR services are aligned with internal needs.
* Identify new opportunities for HR to add value to the business.
* Maintain knowledge of progressive HR practices and key trends.
* Facilitate a strong leadership and coaching culture.
* Maintains an effective level of business literacy about the business, financial position, and mid\-range plans.
* Manage specific projects as determined in the annual HR operational plan and contribute to functional and cross\-functional initiatives.
**Your Skills and Experience**
* Education Required: Bachelor's degree in business administration, HR management or related field.
* Education Preferred: Master’s Degree.
* Experience Required: 10\+ years of progressive HR experience.
* Labor Relations Experience Required: A minimum of 10 years of direct, hands\-on experience managing labor relations in a unionized manufacturing environment. This includes leading negotiations with recognized trade unions on collective bargaining agreements, wage settlements, and long\-term settlements (LTS), as well as managing consultation and co\-determination processes under applicable country labor legislation, including the Industrial Disputes Act, Factories Act, and relevant state\-level statutes. The candidate must demonstrate a proven track record of sustaining productive union\-management relationships while protecting organizational interests, managing conciliation and grievance proceedings, and navigating strike prevention and workforce discipline matters. Experience operating in manufacturing sites, including exposure to Central and State labor authority engagement, is required.
**How We’ll Take Care of You**
At Teva, better health starts from within, and that includes you. From day one, you’ll be supported with benefits designed to help you thrive in and out of work. This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community. When it comes to your career, you’ll be encouraged to explore, evolve, and shape your path. Twist, our one\-stop shop for career development platform, gives you access to a wide range of possibilities, from learning programs and short\-term projects to opportunities for internal growth. Here, you’ll be part of a culture that empowers you to reach your goals and prioritize your wellbeing every step of the way.**Already Working @Teva?**

* Strong graphic design and visual design skills.

* Good communication skills to understand requirements, present ideas, and take feedback.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of motion graphics, reels, product explainer videos, and social media content design.
* Basic understanding of product design, app/web interfaces, and responsive design.
* Ability to create design systems, reusable templates, and brand guidelines.

* Creative, detail\-oriented, and open to feedback.

title: Delivery Coordinator
description:
**We are hiring a Delivery Coordinator to join our engineering delivery team. This is an entry\-level role designed for freshers who are organized, proactive, and want to build a career at the intersection of project management and quality assurance.**  
**Your job is simple to describe but challenging to do well: make sure the projects you support are delivered on time. You will not write code, you will not design test cases on your own, and you will not handle clients. Instead, you will be the person who keeps everyone honest about commitments, surfaces problems early, and makes sure nothing slips through the cracks.**  
**You will work alongside experienced PMs, QAs, and engineers who will train you. Over 12–18 months, you can grow into a full Delivery Coordinator role with ownership of multiple projects.**

**What You'll Do (Day to Day)**

* Attend daily standups and take notes on what every team member committed to — and follow up the next day to check if it actually happened.
* Maintain the project tracker (JIRA / ClickUp) — make sure every ticket has a clear status, owner, and due date. Chase team members to update stale tickets.
* Help the PM prepare sprint plans by listing pending stories, dependencies, and blockers.
* Track QA cycles — when testing starts, how many bugs are open, when signoff is expected — and flag delays early.
* Maintain a simple risk and blocker list for each project; nudge owners to resolve them.
* Prepare weekly delivery status updates for the PM and engineering leads — what's on track, what's at risk, what needs attention.
* Coordinate release readiness checks — make sure deployment steps, smoke tests, and signoffs are completed before any release goes live.
* Sit in on demos and retrospectives, take notes, and convert feedback into tracked action items.

**What We're Looking For**  
This role is about attitude and habits more than experience. We will train you on tools and processes. What we cannot train is:

* Genuine ownership — when something is on your list, it gets done. You do not need to be reminded twice.
* Comfort with follow\-up — you are okay nudging an engineer or QA five times in a day to keep work moving. You do not feel awkward asking 'is this done yet?'
* Attention to detail — you notice when a ticket is missing a due date, when a status hasn't been updated for three days, when a deployment checklist has a step that was skipped.
* Clear written communication in English — short, factual updates without unnecessary jargon.
* Curiosity about software — you do not need to code, but you should be interested in how software is built, tested, and shipped.
* Patience and steadiness — delivery work is repetitive and detail\-heavy. You should find satisfaction in things running smoothly, not chaos.

**Eligibility**

* Any graduate (B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc, BBA, B.Com, or equivalent)
* Comfortable working from our Lucknow office full\-time.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and basic familiarity with any project tracking tool (or willingness to learn quickly).
* Strong written and spoken English.

**What You'll Learn**  
**In your first 6 months, you will get hands\-on exposure to:**

* How real software projects are planned, estimated, and delivered to paying clients.
* Agile and Scrum practices in a working environment, not a textbook.
* Industry\-standard tools — JIRA, Slack, GitHub, staging environments, deployment pipelines.
* How QA, engineering, design, and PM functions work together — and how to spot when one of them is becoming a bottleneck.
* How to communicate risk and status clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Comfortable working from our Lucknow office full\-time.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and basic familiarity with any project tracking tool (or willingness to learn quickly).
* Strong written and spoken English.

description:
**\#\# Job Description: Business Development Executive**

We are hiring a full\-time Business Development Executive who can help the company generate leads, communicate with potential clients, follow up with prospects, and support business growth through outreach and client relationship building.

The ideal candidate should be confident in communication, comfortable with sales conversations, and able to understand client requirements clearly. This role is suitable for someone who is target\-driven, organized, and interested in learning sales, marketing, and client acquisition.

\#\# Role Details

Job Title: Business Development Executive

Role Type: Full\-time

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM

Salary: ₹1000 per month \+ 10% to 20% commission on each sale

Experience: Fresher to 1 year preferred

Work Mode: As per company requirement

\#\# About the Role

As a Business Development Executive, you will be responsible for identifying potential clients, reaching out to prospects, explaining company services, maintaining follow\-ups, and helping convert leads into clients.

You will work closely with the marketing and sales team to manage leads from different sources such as social media, ads, referrals, cold outreach, and inbound enquiries.

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\#\#\# 1\. Lead Generation

Identify potential clients through online research, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and other lead sources.

This includes:

Finding relevant business prospects

Creating and maintaining lead lists

Researching company details and decision\-makers

Identifying client needs and business opportunities

Supporting outreach campaigns

\#\#\# 2\. Client Outreach

Reach out to potential clients through calls, WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn, and other communication channels.

You will be responsible for:

\- Introducing the company and its services  
\- Starting conversations with potential clients  
\- Understanding client requirements  
\- Sharing service details and proposals when needed

Following up regularly with interested prospects

\#\#\# 3\. Lead Nurturing and Follow\-Ups

Maintain consistent communication with prospects and move them through the sales process.

This includes:  
\- Following up with warm leads  
\- Answering basic client questions  
\-Scheduling meetings or calls  
\- Updating lead status regularly  
\- Keeping track of conversations and next steps

\#\#\# 4\. Client Requirement Understanding

Understand the client’s business needs and share the right information with the internal team.

You should be able to:

\- Ask the right questions  
\- Understand pain points  
\- Identify suitable services  
\- Share clear client briefs with the team  
\- Help prepare basic proposals or service recommendations

\#\#\# 5\. Sales Coordination

Coordinate with the internal team to ensure smooth communication and conversion.

This includes:

\- Sharing client details with the concerned team  
\- Coordinating meetings  
\- Keeping records of leads and conversions  
\- Updating daily sales activity  
\- Supporting proposal and quotation follow\-ups

\#\#\# 6\. Target Achievement

Work towards monthly lead generation and conversion targets.

You will be expected to:  
\- Maintain daily outreach activity  
\- Generate qualified leads  
\- Convert interested prospects into meetings  
\- Support client onboarding  
\- Achieve sales and commission goals

\#\# Required Skills

Good communication skills

Basic understanding of sales and business development

Confidence in calling and client conversations

Ability to follow up professionally

Good research and lead generation skills

Basic knowledge of LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email, and Google Sheets

Ability to understand client requirements

Positive attitude and willingness to learn

Target\-driven mindset

Good time management skills

\#\# Preferred Skills

Experience in sales, business development, or client servicing

Knowledge of digital marketing, branding, IT, or creative services

Basic understanding of CRM or lead tracking tools

Comfortable with cold calling and cold outreach

Ability to write simple sales messages and follow\-up texts

\#\# Monthly Responsibilities

Generate new leads

Reach out to prospects through calls, messages, emails, and LinkedIn

Maintain lead sheets and update follow\-up status

Schedule meetings with interested clients

Coordinate with the internal team for proposals and service details

Follow up with prospects until closure

Support client onboarding after conversion

Achieve monthly sales and lead targets

\#\# Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys talking to people, understands basic sales conversations, and is willing to learn how business development works.

This role is best suited for someone who is proactive, confident, consistent with follow\-ups, and motivated by both fixed salary and commission\-based growth.

Pay: From ₹1,000\.00 per month

title: Technical Document Writer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 You will develop accurate, user\-centric, and technically sound documentation for SCADA systems in wind turbine operations, supporting engineering, commissioning, operations, and maintenance teams.
   

  

 The role requires close collaboration with SCADA engineers, network architects, software developers, and field technicians to document highly technical content related to wind farm control systems, networking architecture, data acquisition, and remote monitoring. You will translate complex engineering concepts into clear and usable documentation, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with industry standards.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for SCADA software and network infrastructure
* Develop system architecture and topology diagrams
* Prepare network configuration guides (switches, routers, firewalls)
* Document communication protocols (e.g., IEC 60870\-5\-104, Modbus, OPC)
* Develop installation and commissioning manuals
* Define cybersecurity and access control procedures
* Document alarm handling and data logging processes
* Create end\-user and admin operation guides
* Develop assembly work instructions
* Prepare electrical work instructions and wiring routing for SCADA panels
* Work on product specifications and engineering circuit drawings
* Manage BoM and components documentation
* Translate complex engineering concepts into clear documentation for technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (SCADA engineers, software developers, OT/IT teams, vendors) to gather source content
* Use documentation tools such as MS Office, Excel, Visio, Markdown, LaTeX, XML/DITA, and version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Ensure consistency in format, terminology, and compliance with industry standards and company style guidelines
* Regularly update documentation based on system upgrades, regulatory changes, and new deployments


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 to 6 years of experience
* Experience as a technical writer in the energy, automation, or SCADA domain
* Solid understanding of SCADA systems, industrial networking, and data acquisition principles
* Familiarity with wind turbine operations, control systems, and remote monitoring tools
* Strong grasp of networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, IP routing)
* Proficiency in creating structured technical documents using tools like MS Office, Excel, Visio, Xmetal, LaTeX, Markdown, or Sphinx
* Experience working in Agile engineering environments and interpreting technical drawings and network schematics using NX software / SEE Electrical software


**About The Team**
 You will be part of a collaborative and cross\-functional team supporting SCADA systems and wind energy solutions. The team works closely across engineering, software, and operations functions to ensure accurate documentation and smooth system deployment.
   

  

 The environment encourages knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and high\-quality documentation practices, enabling teams to effectively operate and maintain wind turbine systems while contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions.

At Siemens Gamesa, we are always looking for dedicated individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation.

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under\-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two\-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North\-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower\-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 57 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not\-for\-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.

**Hiring \& Onboarding** \- Organize and conduct Regional Induction Programs for employees to familiarize them with required processes. Conduct 30\-60\-90 connects with new joinees and gather feedback. Prepare action points post feedback and implement the same in discussion with the lead. Track and ensure all new joinee's have received their id cards, assets etc. Assign experienced employees as buddies to assist new joiners and facilitate effective communication between them, fostering a smooth integration process.

**Performance and Rewards** \- Drive goal\-setting process within defined timelines through timely orientation sessions and regular follow\-ups. Initiate confirmation process for all new joinees. Seek inputs for confirmation and ensure timely release of confirmation letters. Drive mid\-year and annual performance appraisal process, and assist in calibration exercise. Initiate PIP for all non\-performing cases in collaboration with business team and ensure appropriate closure. Handle any queries pertaining to goal setting and appraisals. Follow\-up with IT team for timely resolution of any system\-related issues. Collaborate with business teams to complete the annual compensation review process including promotions, ensuring alignment with assigned budgets and defined timelines. Resolve any grievances/ issues pertaining to employee performance \& rewards. Co\-ordinate with respective lead for timely resolution of issues pertaining to incentives / increments.

**Talent Development** \- Ensure execution of trainings as per calendar by liaisoning on internal and external trainers and necessary logistical arrangements for the same. Complete all post training formalities like upload of attendance data, preparation of summary details of training to be emailed to trainer etc. Facilitate the identification of critical roles across departments in coordination with business teams to drive succession planning initiatives. Monitor the closure of Individual Development Plans (IDPs) for eligible employees by maintaining regular follow\-up and tracking progress.

**Emp lifecycle management and HR operations** \- Periodically check with employees for clarity on their job expectations, challenges in managing interdependencies. Co\-ordinate with managers to provide necessary clarity, where needed. Offer insights and recommendations for policy design based on employee feedback and interactions. Conduct retention discussion in partnership with business to reduce attrition levels, conduct exit interviews etc. as part of attrition management. Address employee queries and grievances related to the Human Resource Management System (HRMS) portal and company policies in collaboration with internal teams, ensuring timely and effective resolutions. Manage redesignation, transfer requests, including discussions with the employees, their Manager and HoDs.

**Organizational effectiveness** \- Support in executing periodic programs aimed at engaging the employee\- e.g. Wellness programs, Fun events, Celebration of festivals etc. for the assigned location. Partner with various stakeholders for CSR Programs and encourage employee participation in CSR initiatives. Follow up and seek nominations for various recognition programs and ensure timely submission. Execute various employee engagement activities to inculcate a participatory culture such as Town Halls, Skip level meetings, employee 1\-2\-1s, etc. Drive participation across various teams for vibes survey. Implement the assigned action plan basis the survey findings. Implement various D\&I initiatives and seek active participation from all employees at the location.

**HR Digitization** \- Stay updated on industry best practices and emerging trends in HR digitization and provide inputs on areas of digitization. Actively engage in the implementation of assigned digitization initiatives, to ensure successful integration and adoption of digital solutions. Continuously monitor the performance of digital HR solutions, identify potential issues or areas for improvement, and provide feedback for further evaluation and action. Enforce data security protocols and best practices to safeguard sensitive information.

* Ensure prompt processing and closure of pension claims, including special cases (e.g., death cases) as per management guidelines.

 **Coordination with the EPFO Officials and**

**Ensuring 100% Statutory Compliance**

  

* Approve online PF transfer claims and ensure timely KYC updates and approvals through the EPFO portal.
* Submit documents to RPFC on time and maintain regular communication with EPFO/RPFC offices and PF Trust for updates and grievance resolution.
* Maintain complete and accurate records of all pension\-related documents for audit purposes.

 **Coordination with the PF trust and** **Ensuring 100% Statutory Compliance**

  

* Ensure compliance with PF Trust rules, EPFO guidelines, and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with PF Trust for claim approvals, fund management, and policy implementation
* Process PF Trust claims (advance/withdrawal/settlement) as per Trust rules
* Prepare and submit periodic reports/returns to PF Trust and management

* Prepare monthly EDLI statements along with detailed entry and exit reports, and submit them to the concerned insurance office within the prescribed timeline.

* Update exit dates promptly upon receipt of exit letters and process full \& final PF settlement for all members as per policy.

title: Workday Functional and Product support
description:

We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career—with countless opportunities to explore, build meaningful connections, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible.

**Position Overview**


Sanofi is seeking a **Workday Functional and Product support** to join our **Digital P\&C / People Services** team. This is a critical role responsible for the **functional ownership, optimization, and governance** of the Workday **Core HCM and Security framework** across a complex global environment.


You will lead the design, configuration, and continuous improvement of Workday Core HCM while ensuring **secure, compliant, and scalable access control models** that support Sanofi’s global and local HR operations. This position partners closely with HR, IT, Compliance, and Security stakeholders to deliver a seamless, secure employee and manager experience aligned to Sanofi’s strategic objectives.

**Main Responsibilities**

**Workday HCM Configuration \& Optimization**

* Lead the design, configuration, and enhancement of Workday Core HCM and security ensuring best\-in\-class integration with Compensation, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, and other downstream systems.
* Analyze and remediate existing Workday tenant configurations to improve global consistency, data quality, system performance, scalability, and user experience.
* Drive harmonization of global core data models while supporting localization requirements for countries and regions.
* Manage security impacts arising from new HCM configurations, releases, acquisitions, and organizational changes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Requirements Management**

* Partner with global and local HR, Payroll, IT, and Security stakeholders to gather, analyze, and clarify complex functional and security\-related requirements.
* Translate business and compliance needs into effective Workday HCM and Security solutions while balancing flexibility, risk, and standardization.
* Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on Workday design decisions, tradeoffs, and best practices.

**Innovation, Releases \& Continuous Improvement**

* Stay up to date with **Workday releases, features, and best practices**, proactively identifying opportunities to improve functionality and controls.
* Lead impact assessments and testing related to Workday releases affecting HCM and Security.
* Support adoption of new features that enhance governance, automation, and employee experience.

**Tenant Management \& Environment Governance**

* Act as the functional owner of the Workday tenant, ensuring stability, consistency, and performance across all environments (Production, Sandbox, Preview, and Implementation tenants).
* Govern tenant\-wide configuration standards, naming conventions, transport rules, and promotion processes.
* Coordinate and oversee Workday release management, including preview testing, impact assessments, regression testing, and go‑live readiness.
* Manage tenant dependencies across HCM, Security, integrations, and downstream systems.
* Ensure proper usage of tenants for testing, training, and deployment in line with internal controls and best practices.

**Compliance, Controls \& Documentation**

* Ensure all configurations and security models comply with **regulatory requirements**, internal audit standards, and Sanofi governance policies.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for HCM configurations, security roles, domains, business processes, and controls.
* Support audits by providing clear traceability of access models, approvals, and system controls.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in Workday HCM, HRIS product management, or digital HR transformation in a global organization.
* Proven experience across functional workstreams, PMO governance, vendor/partner management, and executive stakeholder engagement.
* Familiarity with Workday configuration governance and environment/tenant strategies; able to peer coach technical teams (Architect/Config leads) while holding functional accountability.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep expertise in **Workday HCM configuration** and tenant remediation.
* Strong practical knowledge of **Workday Security**, including domains, business process security, roles, and access\-based controls.
* Workday HCM Pro certification preferred; Workday Security experience or certification is a strong plus.
* Experience integrating Workday with local HRIS and third\-party systems is highly desirable.

**Domain \& Business Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of **core HR data models**, employee lifecycle processes, and localization requirements in global organizations.
* Knowledge of HR compliance, data privacy principles, and access governance concepts.
* Ability to translate complex HR and security needs into pragmatic system solutions.

**Advanced Skills**

* Agile mindset and ways of working
* Project management and planning
* Application design and system integration
* Security and compliance of computerized systems
* Strong business acumen
* Collaboration and stakeholder management
* Ability to communicate complexity with clarity and simplicity
* Fluent in English


Why choose us?

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future\-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well\-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high\-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender\-neutral parental leave.
* Opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating with diverse business teams and vendors, working in a dynamic team, and fully empowered to propose and implement innovative ideas.

**Pursue** *Progress*. **Discover** *Extraordinary*.


Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue Progress. And let’s discover Extraordinary together.

Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000104559


  
Embark on a transformative journey as Team Manager\-Know your Customer at Barclays, where you will play a pivotal role to manage operations within a business area and maintain processes with risk management initiatives. You will take ownership of your work and provide first\-class support to our clients with expertise and care.


Critical role covering, managing the BAU activity for the team to keep regulatory visible KRI within group risk appetite due to increased volumes of clients requiring refresh. Team Manager are responsible for managing the team, Monthly performance Assessment, Portfolio reviews along with other tasks \& responsibilities so that clients remain compliant with group policy on KYC Attributes.


Purpose of the role:


* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organization’s products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organization sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organization.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role is based out of Gurgaon.


**Purpose of the role**


To manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives and compliance with relevant regulators.


**Accountabilities**


* Identification of trends and opportunities to improve areas and develop new process and procedures through the monitoring and analysis of operation data and performance metrices.
* Management of operations for a business area and promote efficient processes, risk management and compliance initiatives to support the bank's operations.

* Management of operational professionals and provide guidance, coaching and support to improve colleagues' delivery quality.
* Management and development of KPIs to measure the effectiveness of operation functions, utilising data and technology to support the identification of areas that require improvement.
* Compliance with all regulatory requirements and internal policies related to customer experience.
* Creation of a safe environment for colleagues to speak up, actively and regularly encourage and solicit feedback to ensure people agenda remains focused on the right areas.
* Management of attrition by working closely with HR in implementing retention initiatives for work force.

* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
