title: Talent & Learning Co-ordinator
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Position Title:** 
 Talent \& Learning Co\-ordinator
   

  

**Location:** 
 India (Hyderabad Office)
   

  

**Department:** 
 People Team
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Learning Program Manager
   

  

 Employment type: Full time, regular, Hybrid working arrangement (50% in office), flixbility expected to shift working hours in order to co\-ordinate with global teams.
   

  

**The job**
 As part of the global Talent \& Learning team, you will enable and deliver great learning opportunities for our global AVEVA group employee base, including AVEVA, RIB and ETAP employees.
   

  

 The role incumbent plays a critical role in the development and execution of learning programs, whether in person, virtual classroom or virtual independent learning.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Principal Accountabilities**
* Partnering with the Talent \& Learning team to understand the business needs to deliver great learning experiences.
* Learning program co\-ordination and administration
* Plan, organize, and coordinate training programs, workshops, and webinars
* Schedule training sessions and manage logistics, including venue arrangements, technology platforms, materials and vendors.
* Manage vendor and procurement processes and payments using the appropriate systems and processes
* Handle participant registration, communication, and enrolment processes.
* Maintain accurate records of attendance, evaluations, and other training\-related data.
* Implement assessment strategies to measure the effectiveness of training programs.
* Generate reports on training metrics, participant feedback, and other key metrics.
* Communicate training schedules, expectations, and updates to relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate instructor led training as needed
* Creation and management of courses and programs in Workday Learning, including third part content.
* Provide learner and learning program manager support by addressing queries and troubleshooting issues submitted to a case/ticketing management system.
* Support reporting and analytics requests, both planned and on demand including learning hours, learning spend, recharge and other talent data as required.
* Creation and maintenance of learning content, including presentations, videos and e\-learning with the support of subject matter experts.
* Uphold the standards and tools for learning content, constantly improving the UX of the systems, defining and monitoring catalogue governance, branding standards and ensuring learning is accessible for all learners from a inclusive perspective
* Support maintenance and improvement projects for the Talent \& Learning systems, processes and policies
* Participate in and/or follow industry and vendor webinars, newsletters etc. To develop expertise in talent and learning methods, trends and technologies.


**Important Working Relationships**
 It is important that the Talent \& Learning Co\-ordinator is comfortable interacting with employees of all levels and positions throughout the company. As a global multi\-national company, the incumbent requires sensitivity to other perspectives and cultures.
   

  

 The role reports into the Learning Program Manager. Close working relationships with the Talent \& Learning Program Managers People Services and People Technology are essential to provide a consistent and joined up experience to learning.
   

  

**Essential Competencies, Knowledge, Skills And Experience**
* Candidates should have 4–6 years of overall experience, with at least 2–3 years of relevant exposure within Learning \& Development, People Operations Talent Development, or Learning CoE environments
* Experience of operating in a regional or global role
* Experience in a technical support or frontline support role preferred, including use of ticketing tools
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot software issues
* Strong Excel experience including knowledge of PowerPivot and PowerQuery.
* Must have experience working with LMS, Preferably Workday Learning
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and take initiative while also being an effective team member
* Strong administration, time management and co\-ordination skills, working on multiple activities with SLA deadlines
* Ability to proactively problem solve
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships; interface and influence effectively at all levels of the organisation
* Strong consulting, verbal and written communication and presentation skills
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to handle sensitive information in a confidential manner
* Basic facilitation experience (ILT/VILT) preferred
* Understanding of learning design principles and learner engagement
* Basic experience with e\-learning course creation/editing and video editing tools preferred
* Exposure to behavioural learning, leadership development, or early careers programs


**Behaviours**
* Strong planning, co\-ordination and organisation skills
* Strong focus on efficiency, simplification and continuous improvement
* Strong collaborative approach, with experience of working in a matrixed organisation
* Analytical, logical and creative thinker
* Proactive learner who investigates and evaluates solutions to program and technical questions
* The ambition and drive to work at pace and meet challenging deadlines
* Service excellence and team orientated growth mindset
* Operate calmly and effectively when under pressure
* Comfortable decision maker
* Enthusiastic and passionate team player
* Acts with integrity and flexibility
* Being empathetic and customer focused towards the learner and the learner experience
* Clear and concise communicator able to convey information to learners, vendors and the wider Talent \& Learning team.


**People at AVEVA**
 We’re focused on the single most important part of AVEVA’s business: our employees. From recruitment and reward to experience and engagement, our partnerships across the business create and enable the conditions for every individual to thrive.
   

  

 Doing the best we can for our great people requires quick thinking – and big thinking. Our team is as involved in the day\-to\-day activities affecting the employee experience as we are in the global transformation projects shaping AVEVA’s future. Join us and become part of a diverse and vibrant group that’s striving to make every day at AVEVA even better than the last.
   

  

 Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/
   

  

**India Benefits include:**
 Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support
   

  

 It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
   

  

**Hybrid working**
 By default, employees are expected to be in their local AVEVA office three days a week, but some positions are fully office\-based. Roles supporting particular customers or markets are sometimes remote.
   

  

**Hiring process**
 Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process
   

  

**About AVEVA**
 AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
   

  

 We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
   

  

 AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third\-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
   

  

 AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case\-by\-case basis.

title: Human Resources Lead

The ideal candidate will be responsible for Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Employee Engagement, Performance Management, HRBP activities, and culture\-building initiatives while partnering closely with business leaders to support organizational growth.
 



 This role requires a strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities who can thrive in a fast\-paced and high\-growth environment.

 Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning

* Drive manpower planning and hiring strategies based on business requirements.
* Build and manage sourcing channels including job portals, vendors, LinkedIn, and employee referrals.
* Ensure quality hiring within defined timelines and budgets.



 HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle

* Investigate and document all security incidents and events, recording key details such as the nature of the event, affected assets, and actions taken.
* Escalate confirmed security incidents and complex issues to Level 2/3 analysts or other relevant support teams, providing a detailed handover.
* Follow established incident response procedures for handling standard security events.
* Update and maintain security incident records in the ticketing system, ensuring all information is accurate and up to date.
* Install application patches and signed software updates in order to improve performance, enable additional functionality or enhance security standard including but not limited to Performing Scans, Management of the system, Updating of plugins and patches, etc.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Position Summary:** 




 We are seeking a knowledgeable and self\-driven IT Network Engineer to support our
 



 organization's network infrastructure across processing centers, stores, hubs, and
 



 corporate offices. The ideal candidate will be responsible for configuring, managing, and
 



 troubleshooting networks, ensuring high availability, security, and performance of the IT
 



 infrastructure. This is a hands\-on role involving proactive network monitoring, incident
 



 response, and implementation of network best practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Network Configuration \& Maintenance
 



 \- Install, configure, and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, access points, and other
 



 network devices.
 



 \- Monitor network performance and proactively address latency, connectivity, or
 



 throughput issues.
 



 \- Ensure high availability of enterprise voice and data networks through redundancy
 



 and failover strategies.
 



 \- Implement firmware upgrades, patches, and configuration changes as needed.
 



 Troubleshooting \& Support
 



 \- Respond to network incidents and resolve issues related to LAN/WAN, wireless, and
 



 internet connectivity.
 



 \- Coordinate with ISPs and vendors to troubleshoot and resolve external connectivity
 



 issues.
 



 \- Maintain documentation of network diagrams, configurations, and issue resolution
 



 procedures.
 



  





**Security \& Compliance** 




 \- Ensure secure network access through firewalls, VPNs, and authentication controls.
 



 \- Monitor network for unusual activity, perform vulnerability assessments, and apply
 



 corrective actions.
 



 \- Collaborate with IT security team to implement policies and ensure compliance with
 



 data protection standards.
 



 Collaboration \& Implementation
 



  





 \- Work with cross\-functional IT teams to support new location setups including hubs
 



 and stores.
 



 \- Assist in network capacity planning and infrastructure upgrades.
 



 \- Provide network\-related input for IT infrastructure and service desk projects.
 



 Reporting \& Documentation
 



 \- Maintain logs for network events and generate performance and availability reports.
 



 \- Create SOPs for network deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting procedures.
 



 \- Update inventory records of network devices and components.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills:** 




 Experience:
 



 \- 2–4 years of experience as a Network Engineer or similar role.
 



 \- Experience in managing multi\-site enterprise networks including retail or warehouse
 



 locations.
 



 \- Experience working with ISPs and vendor coordination for field implementation.
 



 Technical Skills:
 



 \-Strong understanding of network protocols: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN, SNMP.
 



 \-Hands\-on experience with Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, or similar networking equipment.

 setup.

 Instant APs and controllers.
 



 \-Knowledge of firewall configuration, ACLs, and secure access policies.
 



 \-Experience with network monitoring tools (e.g., PRTG, SolarWinds, Zabbix).
 



 \-Understanding of wireless networking standards and troubleshooting (2\.4GHz/5GHz
 



 Wi\-Fi).
 



  





**Soft Skills:** 




 \- Strong diagnostic and analytical skills.
 



 \- Effective communication and documentation abilities.
 



 \- Ability to work independently or as part of a team.

**Education \& Certifications:** 




 \- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Networking, Information Technology, or equivalent
 



 experience.

**Why Join Us?**

* tools)

* You are willing to travel as required for project and collaborate with international colleagues.
* Good communication and presentation skills
* Knowledge of Power systems, earthing concepts, EMI\-EMC protections, Validations as per IEC
* 61287, IEC61377 etc
* You will participate in the continuous development of competence and exchange ideas with
* teams on technological \& Process topics

 using

 .

 **WAN/SD‑WAN health dashboards** 
 , ISP status, BGP adjacencies, and alerts at the start of the day.

 , and application performance issues.
* Proactively monitor routing stability and
 **failover/path optimization behavior** 
 .
* Work with
 **ISPs, telcos, and site teams** 
 to resolve circuit and last‑mile issues.
* Analyze recurring WAN defects and contribute to
 **continuous improvement initiatives** 
 .
* Execute planned maintenance such as
 **IOS upgrades, SD‑WAN edge upgrades, new site turn‑ups** 
 , and router refreshes.
* Prepare and execute
 **MOP‑based changes** 
 , perform validations, and share post‑change reports.
* Participate in
 **On‑Call support** 
 , providing timely restoration, updates, and RCAs.
* Develop or enhance
 **automation scripts** 
 to reduce manual WAN/SD‑WAN operational effort.

* Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in
 **Engineering / Technology** 
 .
* **3–6 years of enterprise networking experience** 
 , with:
* **3\+ years of hands‑on WAN / SD‑WAN operational experience**
* Experience working on
 **router lifecycle, refresh, or EOL/EOS activities**

 experience
* Hands‑on exposure to

 , or similar
* Strong understanding of

 .
* Comfortable troubleshooting

 .
* Proactive mindset with ability to identify recurring issues and improve reliability.
* Experience executing
 **planned maintenance, software upgrades, and hardware refreshes** 
 .
* Disciplined approach to
 **configuration standards and documentation** 
 .
* Willingness to participate in
 **On‑Call rotations** 
 .
* Exposure to

description:
**Join our Team**
**About The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an experienced L1 Fault Management Engineer to join our Network Operations team at Ericsson, Noida. In this senior role, you will be a key contributor to our 24x7 global operations environment, leading real\-time alarm monitoring, first\-level fault analysis, and incident management across RAN, IP, Core, and Transmission (TXN) network domains. This role is ideal for seasoned telecom professionals looking to take ownership, drive improvements, and make a broader impact within a global network operations setup.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Core Fault Management**
* Lead 24x7 alarm monitoring and first\-level fault management across RAN, IP, Core, and Transmission network elements
* Identify, analyze, and prioritize complex network faults using Ericsson OSS/NMS and multi\-vendor EMS tools
* Perform in\-depth alarm correlation and first\-level root cause analysis (RCA) before escalation to L2/L3 teams
* Ensure timely service restoration through effective coordination with L2/L3 support and field engineers within defined SLAs


**Incident \& Operations Management**
* Own the end\-to\-end incident lifecycle — from detection and triage to resolution and closure
* Drive adherence to incident, problem, and change management processes per Ericsson's GSC standards and ITIL framework
* Identify recurring fault patterns and contribute to problem management by raising and tracking problem records
* Participate in major incident management (MIM) calls, providing clear and timely stakeholder updates


**Reporting \& Continuous Improvement**
* Generate and present network performance, fault trend, and health reports to operations leadership
* Proactively identify gaps in monitoring coverage and recommend improvements to alarm management processes
* Contribute to SLA reviews and operations performance discussions with internal and customer stakeholders
* Ensure accurate, complete documentation across all fault management systems and drive shift handover quality


**Team \& Knowledge Management**
* Mentor and guide junior L1FM engineers, supporting their technical development and daily query resolution
* Serve as a technical point of contact for one or more network domains (RAN/IP/Core/TXN)
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge base articles
* Support onboarding and training of new team members on tools, processes, and domain knowledge


**You will bring:**
**Experience \& Domain Knowledge**
* 6–12 years of experience in Network Operations / L1 Fault Management in a telecom environment
* Strong hands\-on expertise in one or more domains:
* RAN – 2G/3G/4G/5G Radio Access Network
* IP – Routers, Switches, IP Transport
* Core – MSC, EPC, IMS, 5GC
* Transmission/TXN – SDH, DWDM, Microwave, Packet Transport
* Prior experience in multi\-domain or multi\-technology operations is highly preferred


**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of fault management, alarm correlation, and performance monitoring
* Sound knowledge of ITIL practices – incident, problem, change, and major incident management
* Experience with SLA management and operations reporting in a managed services environment
* Behavioural \& Soft Skills
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to manage complex, multi\-domain fault scenarios
* Proven ability to lead calmly and effectively under pressure during critical network incidents
* Excellent communication skills for coordination across global, cross\-functional teams and customer stakeholders
* Self\-driven with strong ownership, attention to detail, and a continuous improvement mindset
* Willingness to work in a 24x7 rotational shift environment, including weekends and holidays


**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, or equivalent
* ITIL Foundation certification preferred
* Additional domain certifications (Ericsson, Cisco, etc.) will be an added advantage

* Administer distributed/HA ISE deployments, manage certificates, backups, upgrades/patches, and perform log analysis (Live Logs/RADIUS/TACACS\+).

* Administer Infoblox DDI (NIOS/Grid):
* Manage DNS/DHCP/IPAM: zones, views, RPZ, DNSSEC, records (A/AAAA, CNAME, PTR, SRV, TXT/SPF/DKIM), DHCP scopes/options/failover HA, IPAM blocks/subnets, discovery, and workflows.
* Operate Grid master/members, HA pairs, upgrades, hotfixes, Grid backups/restore, logging/syslog, and role\-based access.
* Troubleshoot DNS (recursion, delegation,), DHCP lease/option issues, and IPAM conflicts.
* Automate DDI using Infoblox WAPI, CSV imports, extensible attributes, templates, and (where applicable) cloud adapters for hybrid/cloud IPAM.
* Build IaC \& automation for network tooling and DDI using Terraform and Python; create reusable modules, CI/CD pipelines, and policy\-as\-code
* Design, deploy, and administer SolarWinds Orion platform (NPM, NCM) including discovery, node onboarding, poller tuning, groups and custom dashboards.
* Build robust alerting \& reporting (thresholds, dependencies, alert tuning, escalation policies) and automate runbooks using SWQL, Orion SDK/REST, and PowerShell.
* Plan and execute SolarWinds, Infoblox and ISE upgrades and hotfixes
* Collaborate with Platform, Security, and App teams to enable reliable name resolution, access control, and observability across on‑prem and Azure.
* Ensure security \& compliance: least privilege/RBAC, certificate hygiene, audit trails, data protection, and change management (ITIL).
* Participate in incident management, problem/root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of monitoring, detection rules, and SLOs.
* Support on\-call rotations across time zones with crisp communication and effective handoffs.
* Contribute to switching/routing operations: L2/L3 design, STP/MST, EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP, OSPF/BGP, QoS, ACLs/NAT, IPsec/SSL VPNs; implement standards and remediation via NCM templates.
* Partner with Data Engineering and Dev teams to build and maintain network dashboards and tools for inventory, automation, configuration drift, and incident analytics.







**What would your day look like?** 



* Monitor and triage alerts and requests related to SolarWinds, ISE, Infoblox DDI, and Azure DNS; drive swift mitigation and durable fixes.
* Onboard new devices/services into SolarWinds; tune pollers, thresholds, dashboards, and dependency maps for actionable observability.
* Review ISE Live Logs and RADIUS/TACACS\+ transactions; adjust policy sets, profiling/posture, and guest/BYOD flows as needed.
* Manage DDI changes: create/modify DNS zones/records, DHCP scopes, IPAM allocations; validate change plans and execute during maintenance windows.
* Run compliance and configuration drift checks; remediate non‑compliant network devices with versioned templates.
* Partner with Security/Cyber teams on RBAC, certs/PKI, NAC policies, and audit findings; close gaps with measurable controls.
* Work cases with vendor TAC (Cisco, Infoblox, SolarWinds, Microsoft) for critical issues and escalations; document RCAs and knowledge articles.
* Drive cost, reliability, and performance improvements for tooling (poller capacity, data retention, backup/restore).
* Participate in CAB/Change control, prepare MOPs with peer reviews, and execute changes with back‑out plans.







**Who are we looking for?** 



* Bachelor’s or equivalent in Engineering/Technology.
* 5–8 years total experience in enterprise networking/operations, with:
* 3\+ years hands\-on with Infoblox DDI (NIOS/Grid) across DNS/DHCP/IPAM.
* 3\+ years with SolarWinds (NPM/NCM) including upgrades, alerting, and SWQL/SDK automation.
* 2\+ years with Cisco ISE (802\.1X/MAB, TACACS\+, posture/profiling, guest/BYOD, pxGrid, TrustSec).
* Strong Terraform skills for DNS/Infra modules; proficiency in PowerShell and Python for automation and APIs (Orion SDK/SWIS, Infoblox WAPI, ISE ERS).
* Knowledge of L2/L3 networking: VLANs, STP/MST, LACP/Port‑Channel, OSPF/BGP, HSRP/VRRP, QoS, ACLs/NAT, IPsec/SSL VPNs.
* Familiarity with Azure networking constructs (VNets, Private Endpoints, NSGs/UDRs, vWAN/Firewalls) and their DNS implications.
* Hands\-on with CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), source control (Git), code review, and artifact/version management.
* Experience with alert and event integrations from monitoring and network tools into Azure logic apps and ServiceNow (Incident/Event Management)
* Strong troubleshooting across packets/logs (Wireshark), RADIUS/TACACS\+, DNS resolution chains, DHCP, ALA and Splunk
* Proven incident management and RCA skills; clear written/runbook documentation and stakeholder communication.
* Working knowledge of AGILE practices for incident/change/problem management.

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Cloud Networking
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
 
  
 


**Roku is changing how the world watches TV** 

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 



**About the Team**

  
 






 The Cloud Technology Infrastructure team at Roku is looking for a dedicated engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure Operations group. As a pivotal team, 
 

 we’re
 

  committed to building a scalable, secure, and reusable infrastructure platform that empowers all Roku teams to 
 

 deliver with
 

  speed and confidence. Embracing an ‘Infrastructure as Code (
 

 IaC
 

 ) First’ 
 

 methodology
 

 , 
 

 we’re
 

  eager to onboard a professional 
 

 who’s
 

  ready to partner across teams to build foundational components in Networking, Infrastructure, Identity Management, and Security.
 


  
 




  
 



**About the Role**



  
 






 Are you passionate about streamlining the creation of Cloud infrastructure to achieve maximum efficiency? Do makeshift Cloud services that require manual configuration 
 

 cause
 

  you concern? If you excel in roles that simplify processes for 
 

 engine
 

 ers, enabling them to take ownership with ease, and if 
 

 you’re
 

  an advocate for Infrastructure as Code (
 

 IaC
 

 ), then this opportunity is tailored for you.
 

  
 

 Join us and play a key role in shaping the building blocks that will empower teams across Roku to innovate and thrive.
 


  
 





   
 

  
 




**What you’ll be doing**



  
 



* Collaborate with development teams to enhance their cloud service management capabilities, ensuring they can independently deploy, monitor, and maintain their services.
* Implement monitoring and observability solutions that provide real\-time insights into infrastructure health, enabling proactive issue resolution and system optimization.
* Participate in a shared On\-Call rotation to support critical infrastructure incidents, IAC CI pipeline issues, and cloud networking escalations, ensuring high availability and rapid incident response.
* Design and implement network observability solutions that provide end\-to\-end traffic visibility across cloud networking—including Kubernetes, VPCs, routing, peering, and cross\-cloud connectivity—by collaborating with the Platform team to provide granular, real\-time insights into cloud\-native networking, leveraging visualization platforms and telemetry data to support troubleshooting and performance optimization.
* Partner with technical leaders on the Infra Roadmap to fortify our infrastructure security, leveraging cutting\-edge automation tools for proactive defense strategies.
* Develop frameworks into Infrastructure as Code (IaC) workflows, promoting reusable and adaptable infrastructure components deployed via CI/CD.
* Advocate for cloud cost optimization strategies, ensuring efficient resource utilization and cost\-effective infrastructure management.
* Champion best practices across all functions, including development, QA, and Infrastructure/Operations, to foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.




  
 




**We’re excited if you have**

  
 



* 7\+ years of experience designing and operating scalable, resilient cloud\-native systems, with a focus on automation, observability, and developer enablement.
* Deep expertise in public cloud networking (AWS/GCP), including VPC design, peering, routing, NAT gateways, and service endpoints.
* Developer skills in Python, Java, or Go writing applications and code that will bring together data from disparate systems and will work to help visualize data in a way that will make business decisions easier.
* Experience managing and debugging traffic flows between Kubernetes workloads and cloud\-managed services, with a strong understanding of how service discovery, DNS, and overlay networks impact observability.
* Proven ability to architect and implement network mapping and visualization solutions (e.g., using tools like Istio telemetry, or custom Grafana dashboards) to provide actionable insights into traffic behavior and dependencies.
* Required experience building and managing complex networks in public cloud providers like AWS, GCP and integrating them with cloud\-native platforms, such as Kubernetes.
* Hands\-on advanced experience utilizing cloud\-native services in large scale environments with AWS/GCP using Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform) and other CI/CD tools/services.
* Experience enabling monitoring solutions to visualize and create alerts for core infrastructure with one or more of the following: Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
* Experience driving timely consensus in design with other senior team members across a large organization.
* Experience with how to create infrastructure using CI, Continuous Delivery, and Continuous Deployment workflows; GitLab experience desired.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to help communicate complicated workflows to a broad and diverse user group.
* B.S. or M.S. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.



  
 


**Our Hybrid Work Approach** 

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy.
 



  
 


**Benefits** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**The Roku Culture** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
 



 By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: Robotics Engineer (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
**Our Purpose**
 TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day.
   

  

 We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.
   

  

**O** 
**pportunity Overview**
 We are seeking a versatile and hands\-on Robotics Engineer to join the AI Partnerships team in Bangalore, India. This is a role within an established US\-based team that is expanding into India. You will work at the intersection of robotics, AI, and systems integration, collaborating with model builders and end users to deploy intelligent robotic solutions in real\-world industrial environments.
   

  

 The AI Partnerships team is part of the Chief AI Officer's organization and works across Teradyne's robotics portfolio, including Universal Robots (UR), the global leader in collaborative cobots, and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), pioneers in autonomous mobile robots. Your primary focus will be on robot manipulation applications, with additional involvement in visual inspection and autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) / mobile manipulators.
   

  

 This role requires a well\-rounded robotics engineer with strong software development skills, as well as practical experience in mechanical and electrical integration of robotic systems. You will be responsible for deploying and supporting AI\-enabled robotic solutions that operate reliably in dynamic, production environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Integrate AI models into robotic systems using ROS2, Python, and C\+\+.
* Design, implement, and test robotic subsystems involving mechanical, electrical, and software components.
* Develop and validate manipulation and perception capabilities including object detection, classification, pose estimation, and grasping.
* Work with sensors such as RGBD cameras, LiDAR, and depth sensors to support perception and control.
* Use simulation tools (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim) for development, testing, and synthetic data generation.
* Deploy AI solutions from prototype to production on physical robots, ensuring safety, reliability, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with global teams including Universal Robots and MiR, as well as external model builders and integration partners.
* Support projects in inspection and AMR/mobile manipulator domains, including hardware\-software integration and field validation.


**All About You**
 We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* BS or MS in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–6\+ years of experience in robotics engineering, including system\-level integration of mechanical, electrical, and software components.
* Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of C\+\+.
* Experience with ROS2 and deploying AI models in robotic systems.
* Familiarity with PyTorch or similar ML frameworks.
* Strong understanding of robotics fundamentals including kinematics, motion planning, control, and sensor integration.
* Hands\-on experience with robotic hardware, including wiring, sensor calibration, and actuator control.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with robotic perception in production environments.
* Familiarity with sim\-to\-real transfer techniques.
* Exposure to reinforcement learning or imitation learning.
* Awareness of Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) models.
* Experience with robot programming environments (e.g., URScript, PLCs).
* Background in industrial automation, manufacturing, or logistics.
* Experience with anomaly detection or unsupervised learning.
* Familiarity with safety standards and best practices for deploying robots in shared human environments.


 We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.
   

  

 We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

title: Unreal Engine AI Programmer
description:
**About us** 




 O.A.K Studio is a small, collaborative team building immersive games. We mix industry veterans with passionate newcomers, and we care about clean, systems\-driven code — not quick hacks that we'll be paying for six months later.
 



**The role** 
 We're looking for a C\+\+ programmer to help build the AI and navigation systems for our upcoming project. You'll work closely with our Lead Programmer on entity behavior, pathfinding, and decision\-making — extending Unreal's existing AI frameworks rather than reinventing them, and writing the custom pieces where the engine doesn't go far enough.
 



  





**Compensation:** 
 ₹50,000 / month
 **Location:** 
 \[Remote]
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Implement and tune AI behaviors using Unreal's Behavior Trees, AIController, and navigation systems
* Extend or customize pathfinding and spatial awareness where gameplay needs it
* Work alongside the Lead Programmer to keep AI integrated cleanly with the wider gameplay code
* Debug, profile, and optimize AI logic to hit our performance targets



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 1–2 years of C\+\+ experience (professional, internship, or strong personal/student projects with shipped or near\-shipped work)
* Comfortable working in Unreal Engine C\+\+ — you don't need to know every subsystem, but you've gone beyond Blueprints
* Comfortable with graph theory fundamentals — nodes, edges, traversal, pathfinding concepts (BFS, DFS, A\*, Dijkstra). You should understand how these work conceptually so you can follow and contribute to AI code, not necessarily implement a pathfinder from memory.
* You write code with reuse and clarity in mind (DRY, RAII) and you ask "where should this live?" before you start typing
* You enjoy debugging weird behavior and you're comfortable reading code you didn't write



  





**Nice to have (not required)** 



* Exposure to StateTree, MassEntity, or the Gameplay Ability System
* Any project — personal, jam, student — involving AI for stealth, survival, or horror games
* A GitHub or portfolio showing C\+\+ work, even if it's small
* **How to apply** 
 Send your resume and a link to any C\+\+ work (GitHub, itch.io, portfolio, a Drive folder — whatever you have) to
 **sourabh@oakstudio.co.in** 
 . If you don't have a polished portfolio, a short writeup of a project you're proud of works too.

title: NABH/QCI
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Quality Manager with a minimum of 3 years of hands\-on expertise in implementing and maintaining NABH and QCI accreditation standards across all levels of healthcare delivery. The role demands end\-to\-end ownership of the quality framework—from policy drafting, process gap analysis, and documentation to leading internal audits and representing the organization during final assessments. The ideal candidate will be adept at driving a culture of continuous quality improvement and patient safety, ensuring full compliance with NABH 5th edition (or latest) standards, QCI guidelines, and applicable statutory/regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Accreditation \& Compliance Management**

* Lead the entire NABH/QCI accreditation cycle for hospitals, clinics, or specialized healthcare units (Entry Level, Progressive, or Full Accreditation as applicable).
* Interpret and operationalize all chapters of NABH (Access, Assessment and Continuity of Care, Patient Rights and Education, Infection Control, Facility Management \& Safety, etc.) and applicable QCI schemes (e.g., QCI for Ayush, clinical trials, wellness centres).
* Prepare, review, and update Quality Manual, SOPs, policies, and work instructions in alignment with NABH/QCI standards and local regulations.
* Serve as the primary liaison with NABH/QCI empaneled consultants, assessors, and accreditation bodies; coordinate pre\-assessment, final assessment, and surveillance visits seamlessly.

**2\. Quality Improvement \& Patient Safety**

* Design and drive hospital\-wide quality improvement projects using tools like PDCA, FMEA, RCA, and clinical audits.
* Monitor key clinical and non\-clinical quality indicators (HCAI rates, medication errors, patient falls, waiting time, patient satisfaction scores) and present actionable insights to leadership.
* Lead adverse event reporting, sentinel event analysis, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) implementation.
* Establish and manage infection prevention and control (IPC) programs in close coordination with the infection control team.

**3\. Internal Audits \& Training**

* Plan and conduct regular internal quality audits (clinical and non\-clinical departments) and mock drills to ensure 24/7 survey readiness at all levels.
* Train and mentor departmental quality champions, nursing staff, paramedics, and support services on NABH/QCI standards, documentation practices, and safety protocols.
* Organize ongoing competency\-based training sessions on BLS, ACLS, fire safety, hazardous materials handling, and waste management.

**4\. Documentation \& Data Management**

* Maintain a centralized document control system; ensure version control, periodic review, and easy retrieval of all quality documents.
* Use quality management software or manual trackers to log non\-conformances, audits, and improvement plans, ensuring closure within timelines.
* Prepare monthly quality dashboards and reports for management review meetings (MRM) and statutory submissions.

**5\. Patient Experience \& Regulatory Readiness**

* Implement patient feedback mechanisms; analyse feedback and drive service excellence initiatives to enhance the overall patient experience.
* Ensure compliance with Biomedical Waste Management Rules, AERB, fire NOC, and other statutory/legal requirements as applicable to healthcare organisations.
* Collaborate with HR in credentialing and privileging, medical records department for documentation integrity, and engineering for facility safety.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Hospital Administration / Healthcare Management / Nursing / Life Sciences.
* **Certification (highly preferred):** Certified NABH Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor, Diploma in Quality Management or Healthcare Quality from a recognized institute.
* **Experience:** **Minimum 3\+ years** of dedicated experience in a quality role within a NABH/QCI accredited hospital, multi\-specialty clinic, or diagnostic centre.
* **Proven track record** of successfully steering at least one full cycle of NABH/QCI accreditation or re\-accreditation across all levels (from gap analysis to final assessment).
* In\-depth understanding of the latest NABH standards, QCI framework, clinical governance, and statutory compliance requirements.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* **Technical Acumen:** Mastery of NABH (5th edition) standards and QCI accreditation processes, medical terminology, hospital operations, and patient safety science.
* **Audit \& Analytical Skills:** Ability to plan and execute internal audits, perform root cause analysis, and derive data\-driven decisions using MS Excel/quality dashboards.
* **Communication \& Training:** Excellent command over English and local language(s); capable of drafting clear SOPs and delivering impactful training to multidisciplinary teams.
* **Leadership \& Collaboration:** Strong interpersonal skills to influence across hierarchies—from housekeeping staff to senior consultants—without direct authority.
* **Resilience \& Detail\-Orientation:** Ability to work under pressure during survey periods, manage multiple priorities, and maintain an unwavering focus on micro\-level compliance.
* **Systems Thinking:** Skill in building sustainable quality management systems that go beyond accreditation and become part of daily operations.

**Work Environment \& Benefits**

* Full\-time, hospital\-based role with occasional travel for multisite coordination.
* Opportunity to lead accreditation for emerging specialties (e.g., NABH for Blood Banks, Dental Centres, AYUSH, etc.) and grow into Group Quality Head roles.
* Competitive salary commensurate with experience, health benefits, and continuous professional development support.

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

title: Specialist, Early Careers Recruiter
description:
Job Title: Specialist, Early Careers Recruiter (Talent Acquisition)


**Overview**

At Pearson, we combine world\-class educational content and assessment, powered by services and technology, to enable more effective teaching and personalized learning at scale. We’re committed to a world that’s always learning and to our talented team who make it all possible. From bringing lectures vividly to life to turning textbooks into laptop lessons, we are always re\-examining the way people learn best. We believe that wherever learning flourishes, so do people.


This role sits within our Corporate HR Talent Acquisition function, as part of the Early Careers team, playing a key role in attracting and developing the next generation of talent for Pearson.


In this role, you will attract, engage, and hire high\-potential early careers talent (interns, apprentices, graduates), while also delivering early careers events and programme sessions that support the development of a strong future talent pipeline aligned to business needs.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive employer brand and attraction campaigns targeted at early careers talent
* Develop and implement campus recruitment strategies aligned to business needs
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for early careers roles, ensuring a high\-quality and inclusive candidate experience
* Build and manage early careers talent pipelines through proactive sourcing, university partnerships, and targeted outreach
* Plan and deliver early careers events (e.g. insight sessions, assessment centres, programme briefings)
* Support delivery of the Pearson Global Internship Programme end\-to\-end
* Build and maintain relationships with universities and external stakeholders
* Partner with hiring managers, HR, and Early Careers teams to align on hiring needs and timelines
* Ensure adherence to recruitment processes, governance, and compliance requirements
* Contribute to onboarding and overall programme experience, driving continuous improvement
* Track and report on hiring activity, using data to inform decisions and improve outcomes
* Stay informed of market trends and best practice in early careers recruitment

**Required Knowledge and Experience**

* Strong understanding of early careers recruitment, including internships, apprenticeships, and graduate programmes
* Knowledge of end\-to\-end recruitment processes, including high\-volume hiring and assessment centres
* Understanding of university engagement and campus recruitment strategies
* Awareness of employer branding and candidate engagement approaches
* Understanding of recruitment metrics and data to inform decision\-making
* Knowledge of diversity, equity and inclusion principles in recruitment

**Experience**

* Proven experience delivering end\-to\-end recruitment within early careers or high\-volume hiring
* Experience working with hiring managers and stakeholders to deliver recruitment outcomes
* Experience planning and delivering recruitment events and assessment centres
* Experience building and managing talent pipelines
* Experience supporting early careers programmes or campaigns
* Experience using ATS systems and managing recruitment data
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience working with universities, colleges, or external partners
* Experience contributing to early careers attraction or recruitment strategies
* Experience working in a global or multi\-region environment

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Builds strong relationships and works collaboratively across teams
* Demonstrates a strong passion for early careers and commitment to developing emerging talent
* Communicates clearly and professionally with internal and external stakeholders
* Adapts to change and thrives in a dynamic environment
* Takes initiative and demonstrates a proactive, solutions\-focused mindset
* Applies thoughtful, customer\-focused decision\-making

**Work Model**

This role operates in a hybrid model, combining office\-based and remote working.


**Benefits**

Pearson offers a range of benefits including flexible working, wellbeing support, paid time off, and family\-friendly policies.


**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.


Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E\-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.


If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

title: Manager, South Asia Region
description:
THE ORGANIZATION
Entrepreneurs’ Organization (“EO”) is a global nonprofit membership organization and peer network for entrepreneurs, connecting approximately 20,000 members through more than 220 chapters worldwide. EO’s purpose is to move the world forward by unlocking the full potential of entrepreneurs. Since 1987, EO has helped entrepreneurs achieve transformational growth through life\-enhancing connections, shared experiences, and collaborative learning. Guided by EO’s core values, trust and respect, thirst for learning, think big, be bold, and together we grow, EO’s international staff works across diverse cultures in support of EO’s global community. As an EO employee, you will work in a global entrepreneurial community and have opportunities for learning, collaboration, and professional growth. EO offers a competitive total rewards package, including benefits and professional development support, and a flexible work environment, subject to role, location, and applicable plan terms.  

POSITION SUMMARY*This role supports Entrepreneurs’ Organization. Employment may be through a local employing entity or employer\-of\-record partner, depending on the hiring location.*  

The Regional Manager (RM) is a critical leadership and relationship role within Entrepreneurs’ Organization (EO), serving as the primary staff partner to a portfolio of chapters and regional volunteer leaders. Acting as the connective tissue between chapters, regional leadership, and global priorities, the RM ensures chapter health, leadership effectiveness, and alignment to EO standards while enabling sustainable growth and long\-term impact.  

Through trusted relationships, sound judgment, and strong operational execution, the Regional Manager supports chapters through key moments—strategic planning, leadership transitions, growth initiatives, and challenges—while elevating insights from the field to inform regional and global decision\-making. This role is essential to maintaining consistency, quality, and momentum across EO’s regions worldwide.  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**Chapter Relationship Management*** Manage a portfolio of 10–12 chapters as the primary staff relationship owner.
* Serve as the main liaison to Area Directors (ADs), Chapter Staff, and Chapter Presidents.
* Organize and attend at least one monthly touchpoint with ADs, Chapter Staff, and Presidents.
* Address operational and member\-related issues and escalate risks or concerns as appropriate.

  

**Chapter Health, Growth \& Standards*** Support healthy, sustainable chapters by reinforcing EO standards and identifying risks, including at\-risk chapters, launches, closures, and critical incidents.
* Encourage growth and retention strategies by acting as the primary liaison to Growth \& Member Engagement Directors, Experts, and Chapter Chairs.
* Collaborate with the Growth Portfolio on growth forecasting, incentives, and dashboards.
* Serve as the liaison between chapters and the EO Renewal Team, supporting payment processes, troubleshooting, and quarterly follow\-ups.

**Strategic Planning \& Summits*** Act as regional product ambassador with deep product knowledge
* Support chapter strategic planning and ensure alignment with regional and global priorities.
* Promote, support, and attend Strategy Summits (Annual, Mid\-Year, and Long\-Term Planning) within assigned chapters.
* Collaborate with facilitators to support clear summit outcomes.
* Assist in ensuring summit attendees have completed required Chapter Officer Training.

  

**Regional and Global Programming Support*** Act as Project Manager for key regional events, including Presidents Meetings, Chapter Staff Events, Leadership Summits \& Other Regional Events
* Support additional leadership events such as Global Leadership Conference (GLC), Regional Leadership Academies (RLA), and alignment meetings.
* Encourage cross\-chapter and cross\-regional engagement and represent the region at key events.

  

**Leadership Pipeline \& Stakeholder Management*** Consult with and support the Regional Director in building a strong leadership pipeline and engagement strategy.
* Support Path of Leadership (POL) processes by: Promoting and communicating leadership opportunities, Driving awareness and submissions, Supporting interview coordination as needed
* Attend and engage in Multi\- Functional Director (MFD) and Expert interviews for roles supported by the RM.
* Maintain strong collaboration with key stakeholders involved in interview and ratification processes.

**Regional Council \& Director Support*** Serve as staff liaison to Area Directors, Growth \& Member Engagement Directors, and Experts.
* Support Directors in preparation for Regional Council meetings.
* Contribute regional insight and expertise to long\-term (3\-year) regional strategic planning.

**Data, Insights \& Feedback*** Capture, analyze, and generate data\-driven insights using EO systems and tools to support regional programming and decision\-making.
* Track chapter status, leadership transitions, and health and growth indicators for forecasting purposes.
* Maintain dashboards related to funding and incentive programs.
* Work collaboratively across regions and portfolios to support chapters and share best practices.

  

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED**C****ore** **C****ompetencies*** Ability to manage and support a chapter portfolio as the primary staff relationship owner.
* Strong relationship\-building and stakeholder management skills.
* Sound judgment in identifying risks and escalating appropriately.
* Ability to reinforce standards while maintaining trusted advisory relationships.
* Strong communication, organizational, relationship\-building skills and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Proven experience serving as project manager for regional events.
* Ability to capture, analyze, and interpret data using systems and tools.

  

**E****xperience** **\& E****ducation*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in product engagement, program management, product marketing, member engagement, or a related role.
* Experience working in a membership\-based, nonprofit, association, or global organization strongly preferred.
* Experience working across multiple regions, cultures, or languages is an asset. Fluency in English is required, other language requirements may vary by region.
* Comfort with regional and global travel (35%), including periods of higher seasonal travel demands.

  

**Mindset \& Attributes*** Highly collaborative, adaptable, relationship\-oriented and growth\-oriented.
* Comfortable balancing structure, ambiguity, and innovation.
* Strategic thinker with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and service mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, globally distributed environment.
* High emotional intelligence

  

POSTING DISCLOSURES
Compensation: 206,000\-248,600 INR Gross Monthly Salary
Candidate Data Privacy Notice: HR Candidate Privacy Notice 2026\.pdf
Accessibility / Accommodations: EO will provide accommodations during the recruitment process and employment as required by applicable law. Applicants needing assistance should contact recruitment@eonetwork.org.
WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS / ROLE CONDITIONS* This role is primarily sedentary/light work and requires regular use of a computer, telephone, and video\-conference platforms.
* The role requires the ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally and to participate in virtual and in\-person meetings.
* The role requires travel up to 35%
* The role requires early morning/evening meetings across time zones when applicable
* The role requires lifting/moving up to 5 kgs, as applicable.

  

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY / FAIR RECRUITMENT  

EO is committed to equal opportunity and fair treatment in recruitment and employment.

title: Employee Relations Partner
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
   

  

 Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
   

  

 Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
   

  

**About The Team And The Role**
 The People Experience \- Employee Relations Partner is responsible for supporting functional, jurisdictional and subject matter expertise within the area of Employee Relations, counseling managers and employees, and providing coaching, mentorship and guidance to Leaders and Employees on a broad range of complex and sensitive issues.
   

  

 The ER Partner serves as a critical issue point and works closely with People Business Partners, Legal and other COEs such as Reporting, Comp \& Benefits, and Talent Acquisition and may also be responsible for external Vendor Management. They are a key contributor in streamlining and standardising HR policies and practices!
   

  

**What You Will Accomplish**
* Provides mentorship and coaching to the People Team and/or to managers regarding the interpretation of policies and programs, employment legislation, compliance and operational efficiencies and improvements; manages consultant workload to performance metrics for their jurisdiction; provides specialist expertise and jurisdictionally appropriate legal advice and interpretation on employment legislation for critical and/or complex cases.
* Conducts investigations for increased and/or complex employee relations complaints, grievances and ethics notices (e.g., discrimination, harassment, retaliation)
* Builds and maintains strong, trust\-based relationships with key partners at all levels of the business and collaborates with PBPs, Legal, COEs and external vendors.
* Manages escalations related to external dependencies, bodies and vendors (e.g., record management, disability management, unemployment, labour authorities and government bodies)
* Responsible for building and delivering training to business leaders across the organisation. Also handle onboarding for new People Experience team members. Lead projects related to policy development, implementation, and operational improvements.
* Manages Statutory Labor Compliance for India.


**What You Will Bring**
* Knowledge and understanding of employment legislation, its interpretation and implementation, and of employment practices in India
* Proficiency in HR which they can demonstrate to independently mitigate business, reputational and financial risk
* Leading and participating in large projects
* Passionate about coaching and developing manager capabilities
* Experience at using effective listening, probing and investigatory skills to handle complex, sensitive enquiries and conversations with discretion, composure and compassion
* Analytical attitude, able troubleshooter adept at analysing large amounts of detailed information, diagnosing problems and recommending appropriate solutions to senior business leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-cultural, global organisation and to build strong trust\-based relationships with remote client groups and colleagues
* Ability to deliver high levels of performance and service excellence while managing high volume workload in a collaborative team environment
* Experience in preparation and delivery of presentations/training to managers.


**Experience**
* 8 or more years in area of Human Resources in a global organisation
* 6 years or more, Employee Relations: jurisdictional or functional expertise
* Experience working with remote teams preferred


**Educational Requirements**
* HR Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
* Qualification in Employment Law
* Higher certification in Human Resource Management


**Additional Details**
 eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

description:
**Job Title: HR Manager** 




**Company:** 
 Dlyft India LLP
 



**Location:** 
 Kahni, Rohtak, Haryana
 



**Experience Required:** 
 5\+ Years
 



**Compensation:** 
 Upto
 **₹7 LPA** 
 (Depending on experience and expertise)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 HR Head
 



  





**Role Overview** 




**Dlyft India LLP** 
 is looking for an experienced and execution\-focused HR Manager to lead and strengthen the Human Resources function across the organization. The role requires a capable professional who can manage
 **recruitment, HR operations, employee engagement, compliance, performance management, and organizational development** 
 while supporting the company’s long\-term growth plans.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in
 **building HR systems, managing workforce planning, driving hiring strategies, improving employee performance, and creating a high\-accountability work culture** 
 within manufacturing, industrial, OEM, or fast\-growing business environments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




*Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning* 



* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for leadership, corporate, technical, production, sales, operational, and support functions
* Build strong hiring pipelines through job portals, consultants, references, social hiring, and strategic sourcing channels
* Improve recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and turnaround time
* Coordinate manpower planning with department heads based on business growth requirements
* Strengthen employer branding and recruitment processes to attract quality talent
* Handle both
 **blue\-collar and white\-collar hiring** 
 operations



*HR Operations \& Compliance* 



* Manage attendance, leave records, payroll coordination, employee documentation, and HR administration processes
* Ensure implementation and monitoring of HR policies, company rules, and
 **statutory compliance** 
 requirements
* Oversee onboarding, confirmations, transfers, employee records, disciplinary processes, and exit formalities
* Develop and improve
 **HR SOPs** 
 , reporting systems, documentation structures, and operational workflows
* Maintain HR data accuracy, reporting, and employee lifecycle management systems



*Culture, Engagement \& Retention* 



* Build a disciplined, ownership\-driven, and performance\-oriented work culture
* Drive employee engagement, retention, motivation, and recognition initiatives
* Improve communication and coordination across departments and teams
* Support leadership in strengthening employee morale and workplace culture
* Identify employee concerns and implement practical solutions to
 **improve stability and retention**



*Performance Management* 



* Support implementation of
 **KPI, KRA, and performance evaluation** 
 systems across departments
* Coordinate with department heads to improve accountability, productivity, and workforce efficiency
* Assist in performance review processes and employee development planning
* Support organizational structuring and manpower optimization initiatives
* Help create measurable performance tracking systems aligned with business objectives



*HR Strategy \& Organizational Development* 



* Support management in strengthening HR systems and organizational processes
* Assist in building scalable HR structures aligned with business growth plans
* Contribute to workforce planning, leadership development, and organizational improvement initiatives
* Participate in policy development,
 **process improvements** 
 , and employee development programs
* Support management in creating strong teams and future\-ready organizational structures



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong leadership and people management capabilities
* Expertise in recruitment, HR operations, employee engagement, and compliance
* Experience building and improving HR systems and processes
* Strong communication, negotiation, and coordination skills
* Ability to work in fast\-paced and growth\-oriented environments
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Ability to manage both strategic and operational HR responsibilities
* Experience handling blue\-collar and white\-collar workforce



  





**Good to Have Skills** 



* Experience in manufacturing, OEM, industrial products, or startup environments
* Exposure to scaling HR operations in growing organizations
* Knowledge of
 **KPI, KRA** 
 , and performance management systems
* Experience in
 **SOP creation** 
 ,
 **policy development** 
 , and
 **organizational structuring**
* Familiarity with HRMS systems and HR process automation



  





**Qualification** 



* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or related field preferred
* Additional certifications in HR strategy, labor laws, or organizational development will be an advantage
* Relevant experience in HR management roles within manufacturing or operational businesses preferred



  





**About Dlyft India LLP** 




 Dlyft India LLP is a growing manufacturing and infrastructure solutions company focused on delivering high\-quality products with strong operational standards and innovation\-driven execution.
 



 The company operates as an OEM manufacturer for event infrastructure systems and bicycles, serving businesses across multiple industries in India. Our focus is on building scalable systems, strong teams, and long\-term business relationships while maintaining quality, reliability, and operational excellence.
 



 At Dlyft, we believe growth comes from ownership, accountability, innovation, and empowering people to lead.
 



  





**Our Vision** 




 To become a trusted and innovation\-driven manufacturing company known for quality products, strong systems, operational excellence, and long\-term customer relationships across India and global markets.
 



  





**Our Mission** 



* To manufacture reliable and high\-quality products with consistent operational excellence
* To build scalable systems and strong leadership teams for long\-term growth
* To create a performance\-driven workplace focused on ownership, learning, and innovation
* To continuously improve through technology, efficiency, and customer\-centric execution



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Opportunity to lead and strengthen the HR function with high ownership
* Direct exposure to leadership and strategic business operations
* Fast\-growing company with strong expansion plans
* Opportunity to build systems, teams, and culture from the ground level
* Dynamic and execution\-driven work environment
* Long\-term career growth opportunities within expanding business verticals



  





**Career Growth** 




 This role offers strong long\-term growth opportunities with the potential to lead larger HR operations, organizational development initiatives, workforce expansion projects, and future business verticals as the company continues to scale.

About IntouchCX
  
  

IntouchCX is a global leader in customer experience management, digital engagement, and AI and automation solutions. We immerse ourselves in your world with curiosity, creativity, and innovation to deliver exceptional results. For over 20 years, we have scaled with soul to become a disruptive industry leader by building trusted long\-term relationships with our brand partners and empowering our people to drive positive change.

We are changing the way people think about customer care, and we need your help!
  
  

We’re seeking a Recruitment Supervisor to oversee all Customer Service Representative recruiting activity. This role will be responsible for hiring, community sourcing and making proactive recommendations. We’re looking for a leader who has the vision, experience and passion to contribute to our culture and the success of our programs.

* Oversee Recruitment operations and manage the front desk
* Responsible for the hiring process for our major partners
* Direct the efforts of the Recruiter and Recruiting Associate
* Develop plans and timelines to meet staffing needs
* Interface and build relationships with Operations and Human Resources to ensure business goals are met in compliance with applicable regulations and policy

* Participate and help organize job fairs, open houses and recruiting events

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Excellent attention to detail, problem solving skills and organizational skills
* Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and demonstrate flexibility
* Ability to effectively interact with all levels in the organization

title: Assistant Manager-People Operations
description:
Rentomojo is a leading rental solutions provider redefining the way people access and experience lifestyle products. We believe in delivering quality, flexibility, and innovation while ensuring operational excellence in every area – including compliance. As part of our growing People Operations team, we are looking for a Compliance – Assistant Manager to strengthen our statutory and HR compliance function in partnership with our external compliance vendor.
   

  

**Eligibility Criteria**
* Strong knowledge and experience in HR / labour compliances, with expertise in Shops \& Establishments Act and Factories Act preferred.
* Proven experience in handling multi\-state compliances.
* Preferably from compliance consultancy firms, compliance\-focused companies, retail sectors, or service\-based sectors.
* Fluency in English and Hindi; knowledge of Kannada or other South Indian languages will be an added advantage.
* Experience interacting with labour inspectors will be considered a plus.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Compliance Management**
* Ensure 100% compliance with all applicable labour laws and HR statutory requirements across multiple states.
* Act as the checker for compliance documentation uploaded by the external vendor on the Complinity compliance tool, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
* Perform internal audits of compliance records and conduct vendor audits to verify that statutory obligations are met in a timely and accurate manner.
* Monitor, review, and verify monthly, quarterly, and annual compliance reports from the vendor.


**Statutory Payments \& Filings**
* Ensure timely execution of statutory payments, filings, remittances, and returns.
* Proactively track and prevent delays in remittances, filings, or returns to avoid penalties.


**Vendor Coordination**
* Act as the primary liaison with the external compliance vendor, ensuring deliverables are met as per agreed timelines.
* Review vendor invoices to confirm billing accuracy; raise and resolve discrepancies as required.


**Regulatory Updates \& Advisory**
* Stay updated on new labour laws, notifications, and amendments; provide actionable advice to internal stakeholders.
* Support IPO\-related HR compliance activities and any other corporate compliance requirements.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with Finance, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure smooth execution of compliance activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams wherever vendor input or support is required for compliance execution.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Act as a maker for compliance uploads when necessary, in addition to the checker role.
* Ensure continuous improvement in compliance tracking processes and documentation standards.


**Key Skills**
* Strong understanding of labour laws and HR compliance frameworks.
* Detail\-oriented with strong auditing and verification skills.
* Proficiency in compliance tools like Complinity.
* Excellent communication and vendor management skills.
* Ability to work under tight deadlines and in a dynamic environment.
